6\. **Testing and Quality Assurance:** Plan, coordinate, and execute system testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Ensure that configured solutions meet business requirements and are defect\-free.

7\. **Change Management and Stakeholder Communication:** Implement change management strategies to facilitate ERP adoption and minimize resistance. Communicate project status, risks, and issues effectively to project stakeholders and management.

8\. **Data Migration and Integration:** Collaborate with technical teams to ensure successful data migration from legacy systems to the ERP platform. Define data migration strategies, perform data cleansing, and validate data integrity.

9\. **Continuous Improvement and Best Practices:** Recommend process improvements and ERP system enhancements based on industry trends, client feedback, and system performance. Stay abreast of ERP software updates and best practices.

10\. **Project Coordination and Delivery:** Manage project timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure successful ERP implementation projects. Coordinate activities with cross\-functional teams and third\-party vendors.

description:
**Junior Electronics Engineer – Bedrock Foundry (Onsite, Kozhikode)**

**About the Company**

Bedrock Foundry is a technology\-driven company building scalable and reliable software and hardware systems. We focus on high\-performance engineering, clean architecture, and modern hardware\-software integration.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a brilliant, hands\-on **Junior Electronics Engineer** to join our hardware engineering team in Kozhikode. This is a full\-time, onsite role designed for freshers, dedicated electronics hobbyists, and entry\-level engineers (0 to 1 year of experience) who love working at the circuit level. If you spend your free time designing custom PCBs, soldering components, and making microcontrollers communicate with hardware sensors, you will fit right in.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Schematic \& PCB Design:** Assist in designing, routing, and reviewing schematic diagrams and multi\-layer Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) for custom hardware modules.
* **Hardware Testing \& Debugging:** Use laboratory tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers) to bring up new boards, trace signals, and troubleshoot hardware failures or signal noise.
* **Prototyping \& Soldering:** Hand\-solder surface\-mount technology (SMT) and through\-hole components onto prototype boards with precision.
* **Component Selection:** Research and source electronic components, verify datasheets, and maintain clean Bills of Materials (BOM) for manufacturing.
* **Firmware Collaboration:** Work hand\-in\-hand with software and robotics engineers to test hardware peripherals and ensure seamless integration with microcontrollers.

**What You’ll Gain**

* True hands\-on experience taking hardware designs from an empty schematic sheet all the way to a manufactured, functional physical product.
* Deep technical mentorship from senior system engineers on signal integrity, power management, and noise reduction.
* **Free Company Benefits:** Comfortable accommodation, daily meals, and a premium gym membership to ensure a seamless relocation to Kozhikode.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 0–1 year of electronics hardware experience (**Freshers with a strong portfolio of personal or academic hardware projects are highly encouraged to apply**).
* **Education:** B.Tech / BE / Diploma in Electronics \& Communication (ECE), Electrical \& Electronics (EEE), Mechatronics, or equivalent practical hardware background.
* **Core Skills:** Solid understanding of analog/digital circuit design fundamentals, power regulation (LDOs, buck\-boost converters), and communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART).
* **Mindset:** Extreme attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a genuine passion for physical electronics craftsmanship.

**Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)**

* High proficiency with modern PCB design tools like **KiCad, Altium Designer, or Autodesk Fusion Electronics**.
* Exceptional bench skills (clean manual soldering of 0603/0402 components and small IC packages).
* Basic exposure to microcontroller programming (C/C\+\+ in Arduino IDE, ESP\-IDF, or STM32Cube) to write quick test firmware scripts.

**Job Details**

* **Location:** Onsite – Kozhikode, Kerala
* **Job Types:** Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher
* **Schedule:** Day shift

**How to Apply**

If you are fascinated by hardware architecture, love diagnosing circuit boards down to the trace, and want to build cutting\-edge physical systems, apply now to join Bedrock Foundry.

Important: Please include a link to a portfolio file, a GitHub hardware repository, or high\-quality photos/videos showcasing the schematics, PCB layouts, or physical circuit boards you have personally designed and built. Applications highlighting real hardware projects will be prioritized.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
Read this fully before applying. This role isn't for everyone.

We're an AI startup building a virtual try\-on platform for fashion brands globally. Our customers are apparel brands across the US, UK, Canada, and India. We're small, fast, and growing — and we're looking for one person to help run our marketing engine.

**This is an ownership role, not a desk job.** You'll run real marketing from day one, guided by a founder who has already built and successfully exited a technology company. Most people never get this kind of direct, close\-range mentorship this early in their career. Here, it's the job.

**What you'll do**

You'll own work across our core channels — and go deep where you're strongest:

* Plan, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn, X, and Instagram
* Execute our SEO program — blog content, rankings, backlinks, directory listings
* Track campaign metrics and keep the whole program organized and on time
* Grow into paid ads (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) as you build the fundamentals
* Manage GTM end\-to\-end

You'll have a documented playbook and weekly mentorship. You're improving a system that already works — not guessing alone.

**Who thrives here**

* 0–2 years in digital marketing, or a strong fresher with real projects to show
* Genuinely organized — you juggle many moving parts without dropping them
* A sharp writer who can make an idea land in two sentences
* A self\-starter who moves fast, measures results, and improves without being told

**Who should not apply:** anyone looking for a slow, predictable 10\-to\-6\. The pace here is real and the standards are high. We reward it with growth most roles can't offer.

**Why it's worth it**

* Real ownership from day one — you run the work, not shadow it
* Rare, direct mentorship from a proven founder while you own your channels
* Fast growth: prove yourself in the first months and step into a senior, full\-time mandate with more scope and pay
* You'll understand how a global product actually goes to market — a skill that compounds for your whole career

**₹20,000–25,000/month**, based on experience and demonstrated skill.

**To apply:** Send your CV plus 5–6 sentences answering this — *pick any fashion brand you like and tell us one specific thing you'd do to get more people to discover it.* We read every response, and it matters more than your resume.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 DevRev’s Knowledge team is hiring a technical writer who has strong technical proficiency and strives for simplicity. You’ll join a small team that has built our external documentation set from scratch and ships on a rapid product cadence. This role reports to the Head of Knowledge Ops.The Technical Writer is responsible for ensuring that documentation for our product is useful, findable, clear, correct, comprehensive, and consistent \- and that it directly contributes to customer self\-service and product adoption.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Write, review, publish, and maintain product documentation on the support portal, covering features across our AI product (Computer), platform capabilities (access control, customization, connectors), and integrations (Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, etc.).
* Ensure documentation is available at launch and then deepen, expand, and improve it over time based on customer needs, support patterns, and product evolution. Sustaining documentation is as much of the job as creating it.
* Partner with product managers who own the content for their areas. Your job is to help them get documentation ready: structuring, drafting, editing, publishing, and driving the review process to completion on schedule.
* Identify and address knowledge base gaps by analyzing support ticket themes, deflection data, and customer feedback \- not waiting for requests to arrive.
* Maintain and improve the documentation infrastructure: contribute to article health metrics, flag platform issues that affect KB quality (e.g., metadata hygiene, article visibility settings), and propose operational improvements.
* Hold subject\-matter experts accountable for technical reviews. Documentation at DevRev is a cross\-functional commitment: product managers own accuracy, and you drive the process that ensures it.
* Identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation to scale documentation production, including AI\-assisted drafting, content audits, and workflow automation.


**What You'll Bring**
* 3 \- 6 years writing and maintaining software product documentation, preferably for SaaS or platform products.
* Strong command of documentation best practices: information architecture, essentialism, clear and direct prose.
* Experience sustaining a documentation set over time \- not just writing first drafts, but iterating, expanding, consolidating, and retiring content as products evolve.
* Comfortable with knowledge base platforms, markdown, and version\-controlled content workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to learn complex technical domains quickly \- AI, APIs, integrations, access control, and similar concepts will be your daily vocabulary.
* Effective async communicator across time zones.
* Interest in using AI tools to augment documentation workflows for drafting, translation, content audits, or summarization.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Previous startup experience, demonstrating adaptability and proactivity in fast\-paced environments.
* Familiarity with AI products, developer tools, or platform products with complex permission models.
* Experience using analytics (article views, search queries, deflection rates) to prioritize documentation work and measure impact.


*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

title: IT Administrator (macOS & JumpCloud Specialist)
description:
### **About the Role**


We are looking for a hands\-on, proactive **IT Administrator** to take complete ownership of our internal IT infrastructure and asset management lifecycle. In this role, you will be the backbone of our daily operations, ensuring our team has seamless, secure, and uninterrupted access to the tools they need.
Our ecosystem is built on a **macOS\-based** fleet, using **JumpCloud** as our core Directory Service and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution, alongside **Google Workspace**. If you are a structured, security\-minded professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and takes pride in maintaining a bulletproof IT setup, we want you on board.### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Keka Asset Management Ownership:** Take full administrative ownership of the Keka asset management module. Track, tag, and log all hardware assets (MacBooks, monitors, peripherals) from procurement through disposal, ensuring the Keka ledger remains the absolute source of truth for inventory.
* **Inventory Auditing \& Reconciliation:** Conduct regular physical and digital IT audits to reconcile Keka’s asset registry against active systems in **JumpCloud**. Cross\-verify that device assignments in Keka perfectly match live machine deployment and system insights.
* **HR\-IT Lifecycle Integration:** Partner closely with HR to streamline tech onboarding and offboarding pipelines. Ensure Keka automated triggers for asset allocation on Day 1 and physical asset recovery during exit clearances are executed flawlessly.
* **MDM \& Identity Management:** Own the **JumpCloud** architecture. Handle user provisioning/deprovisioning, enforce security policies, manage system insights, and deploy software configurations remotely across the fleet.
* **macOS Fleet Management:** Act as the primary expert for all MacBook\-related technical support, ensuring all hardware is optimized, secure, and properly enrolled via Apple Business Manager (ABM) into JumpCloud.
* **Google Workspace Administration:** Manage the complete Google Suite environment, including user accounts, shared drives, security groups, email retention policies, and third\-party app integrations.
* **Network \& Infrastructure Support:** Maintain and troubleshoot local office network infrastructure (Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, firewalls, and ISP coordinates) to ensure zero downtime.
* **Endpoint Security:** Implement and enforce robust security protocols (Endpoint security, MFA, password policies, and access controls) across all endpoints and cloud applications to safeguard company data.

### **Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years of dedicated experience in IT Administration, System Administration, or a similar role, ideally within a high\-growth startup or tech\-driven organization.
* **MDM Expertise:** Proven, hands\-on experience configuring and managing **JumpCloud** for macOS devices.
* **OS Specialty:** Deep technical knowledge of macOS hardware and software troubleshooting. Familiarity with Apple Business Manager (ABM) and Device Enrolment Program (DEP) is required.
* **Cloud Productivity Platforms:** Strong administrative knowledge of **Google Workspace** (G Suite).
* **Networking Fundamentals:** Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and basic office network architecture.
* **Problem\-Solving Mindset:** Exceptional organisational skills with a proactive approach to keeping physical tracking and digital systems perfectly synchronized.

description:
Job Description

HR \& Admin Executive

Company: Spartek Group

Location: Chennai

Department: Human Resources \& Administration

Reports To: Chairman's Office / Head – HR \& Administration

About Spartek Group

Spartek Group is a diversified building materials organization with interests in

Tiles, Sanitaryware, Construction Chemicals, Flooring Solutions, Precast

Construction, and other emerging businesses.

We are looking for a proactive and organized HR \& Admin Executive to support

our growing operations by managing recruitment, employee engagement, HR

operations, and office administration.

Position Summary

The HR \& Admin Executive will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR

operations, recruitment, employee onboarding, statutory compliance support,

payroll coordination, office administration, vendor management, and

employee engagement initiatives.

The role requires excellent organizational skills, confidentiality, and the ability

to work closely with senior management.

Key Responsibilities

Human Resources

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment process including sourcing, screening,

interview coordination, offer rollout, and onboarding.

* Coordinate with consultants, colleges, and job portals for hiring

requirements.

* Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR documentation.
* Prepare appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters,

relieving letters, and other HR communications.• Coordinate employee induction and orientation programs.

* Track employee attendance, leave management, and regularization.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the Accounts team.
* Maintain employee database and HR MIS reports.
* Support performance appraisal process and probation reviews.
* Organize employee engagement activities, training programs, and

wellness initiatives.

* Ensure HR policies are communicated and implemented effectively.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and maintain confidentiality.

Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day office administration activities.
* Supervise housekeeping, security, office maintenance, and facility

management.

* Coordinate travel bookings, accommodation, and logistics for employees

and management.

* Manage office assets, stationery, consumables, and inventory.
* Coordinate with vendors for office maintenance and procurement.
* Ensure proper maintenance of office infrastructure and equipment.
* Maintain AMC records and vendor contracts.
* Support event management, meetings, conferences, and company

functions.

* Coordinate courier, dispatch, and document management activities.

Compliance \& Documentation

* Support statutory compliance related to HR and labour regulations.
* Maintain employee records in compliance with company policies.
* Coordinate documentation related to ESI, PF, gratuity, and other

statutory requirements.

* Assist during internal and external audits.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare monthly HR dashboards and recruitment reports.
* Track manpower planning and hiring status.
* Generate attendance, leave, and attrition reports.
* Maintain HR documentation and organizational records.Required Qualifications
* MBA/MSW/PGDM in Human Resources or related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, or equivalent

may also be considered with relevant experience.

Experience

* 2–5 years of experience in HR \& Administration.
* Experience in manufacturing, construction, or building materials

industry will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of HR processes and best practices.
* Understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, PF, ESI, and payroll

coordination.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and HRMS software.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and senior

management.

* Strong documentation and reporting skills.

Key Competencies

* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
* HR Operations
* Employee Relations
* Office Administration
* Vendor Management
* Documentation \& Compliance
* Communication Skills
* Time Management
* Problem Solving
* Attention to DetailPreferred Candidate Profile
* Self\-driven and proactive professional.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Professional attitude with excellent follow\-up and execution capabilities.
* Willingness to take ownership beyond defined responsibilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Recruitment Turnaround Time (TAT)
* Employee Onboarding Completion
* Employee Retention \& Engagement
* Attendance \& Leave Accuracy
* Payroll Input Accuracy
* HR Documentation Compliance
* Office Administration Efficiency
* Vendor Performance \& Cost Optimization
* Employee Satisfaction
* Timely MIS Reporting

Group by strengthening both people processes and administrative operations

while supporting the organization's expansion across multiple business

verticals.

The Pine Crest School, established in 1991 at Gurugram (formerly Gurgaon), Haryana is an English medium CBSE affiliated school, and caters to a diverse student body while upholding a strong ethos of inclusivity, innovation and social responsibility.

Our school has spacious and well equipped classrooms, science and computer laboratories, and our library is fully stocked with books, periodicals, and digital resources. Our world class sports facilities include playgrounds and games courts.

Our students consistently achieve good results in the board exams, attesting to their depth of knowledge, critical thinking skills, and overall preparedness. Also our students excel in individual and team sports.

We value the well being and satisfaction of our employees, and provide excellent working conditions to foster the spirit of teamwork. **Company:** Casagrand Premier Builder Limited

**Location:** Chennai, TN (On\-site)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Urgency:** Immediate Joiners

**About Casagrand**

Casagrand Premier Builder Limited is a titan in the real estate sector, dedicated to "Building Aspirations" and delivering unparalleled value. With a 22\-year legacy, we have transformed over 53 million sq. ft. of land into thriving communities across South India. With 160\+ landmark properties, 55,000\+ satisfied families, and a ₹8,000\+ crore project pipeline, we are shaping the future of urban living.

**The Role**

We are seeking a high\-energy Site Engineer to drive excellence at our Chennai project sites. You will be the boots\-on\-the\-ground lead, ensuring that structural integrity, finishing quality, and safety standards are never compromised. This role is perfect for a civil professional who thrives on seeing blueprints turn into landmarks.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* On\-Site Execution: Supervise daily construction activities, ensuring all civil and structural work aligns with approved drawings and quality benchmarks.

\* Finishing Excellence: Oversee high\-end residential finishes, maintaining the premium aesthetic Casagrand is known for.

\* Project Tracking: Monitor timelines rigorously, coordinating with contractors and vendors to prevent bottlenecks.

\* Resource Management: Optimize the use of materials, machinery, and manpower to reduce waste and ensure cost\-efficiency.

\* Safety \& Compliance: Enforce strict adherence to safety protocols and regulatory standards on\-site.

\* Reporting: Provide data\-driven progress updates to project managers and stakeholders.

Candidate Profile \& Requirements

**We are looking for candidates who can hit the ground running. The following criteria are mandatory:**

\* **Experience:** 1 to 6 years of hands\-on experience in High\-Rise or Residential projects.

\* **Technical Edge:** Expertise in structural engineering principles and a "keen eye" for high\-quality interior/exterior finishes.

**\* Education:** B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.

\* **Location:** Currently based in Chennai or within Tamil Nadu.

\* **Availability:** Must be available for an in\-person interview on or before 14th March 2026\.

\* **Joining Timeline:** Immediate joiners (or those with a notice period of \<15 days) are preferred.

**Technical \& Soft Skills:**

\* Proven ability to problem\-solve and make critical decisions under pressure.

\* Strong communication skills to manage diverse labor teams and project stakeholders.

\* Proficiency in quality control (QC) and safety audit processes.

**Why Join South India’s Leading Developer?**

Casagrand is not just a real estate company; we are a legacy in the making.

\* **Chennai’s \#1 Developer:** Consistently ranked as the top builder in Chennai.

\* **South India’s Powerhouse:** Leading the market across Bengaluru, Coimbatore, and Hyderabad with a massive ₹8,000\+ Cr project pipeline.

\* **Unmatched Employee Perks:** We believe in rewarding excellence. Our team members enjoy:

\* **International Reward Trips:** Annual company\-sponsored trips to destinations like London, Barcelona, and Switzerland.

\* **Premier Security:** Medical insurance and a unique "Family Support Policy" providing 50% salary to the spouse for 10 years in unforeseen circumstances.

**\* Fast\-Track Career:** Join a team of 2,300\+ in\-house engineers with the industry's most aggressive promotion cycles.

You will be accountable for all of the Enterprise Architect responsibilities while also leading, growing, and inspiring the team. * Own team operational health — including headcount planning, budget inputs, tooling, and process improvements.

**What would you do?** Job Description Responsible for repeatable, predictable and measurable operations which includes but is not limited to the following: 1\. In\-depth understanding of HRO processes supported by Accenture Drives activities to meet requirements (e.g., timelines, quality, and costs) \& does whatever is needed to complete the task on time and error free. 2\. Drive Operational Excellence within Team and support OE Focal. Liaise with Operational Excellence Team as required. 3\. Raises relevant quality and/ or scope issues which may impact delivery and streamlines decision\-making processes where possible. . Must have clear understanding of the existing metrics in the process, how they are measured and improvise the measurement system to make it more effective and transparent. Detailed understanding of Process metrics e.g. SLA, OLA, KPI. Liaise with Service Management Team on reporting performance measures to the Client. 5\. Escalate issues and seek advice when faced with complex issues/problems. 6\. Ensure that Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans are up to date and tested periodically. Liaise with BCM Team and Local IT on Testing. 7\. Creates a logical plan, realistic estimates and schedule for an activity or project segment. 8\. Ensures progress, issues and agreements are properly documented and acted upon. 9\. Assist Team with performing “Root Cause Analysis” on issues faced and suggest appropriate corrective and preventive actions. 10\. Support in Knowledge Transfer of any process/client and acquires in depth knowledge of process, as required. 11\. Participates in various Internal or Client initiatives related to Process. 12\. Ensure the process dashboards and visual management displays are reviewed on an ongoing basis and up\-to\-date. 13\. Actively participate in all process related business meeting in\-person or virtually through conference calls. 14\. Liaise with Accenture Local IT to escalate Technology issues being faced by the Team. 15\. Participate in and/or support during Client visits. 16\. Must be able to propose process improvement ideas which can reduce time, improved accuracy or enhance controls 17\. Must read, understand and analyze client process as per the business rules. Should become a People relations process expert within first 4 months.  

**What are we looking for?** Education Equivalent Minimum Graduate Experience • At least 5 years of HR Experience • Employee Workforce administration experience a plus • Workday Experience a plus • HR Domain certification would be a plus • Strong MS Office and Excel skills • Proficient with Operational Excellence Practices • A minimum of 2 years of prior people management experience. Knowledge/Skills Requirements: • Good organizational \& prioritisation skills. • Analytical and problem\-solving skills. • Multi\-cultural awareness. • Passion for customer service. • Team player. • Results \& detail\-oriented • Focus on high data accuracy. • Quality driven – in communications and all system transactions. • Ability to deal with customer complaints in a professional and friendly manner and escalate where appropriate • Good written and verbal skills. Strong English language communication skills Excellent Customer Service skills Core Competencies – • Professional Qualities • Good oral and written communication skills • Ability to identify and effectively use resources • Excellent customer service skills • Operational Excellence skills Working Conditions – US Hours • Shift timings (7am – 3pm ET,/ 5:30pm \-1am IST) (1pm to 9pm ET/ 11:30pm – 7am IST) • Candidate should be willing to work in Rotational Night shifts.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •Team Development: Create a performance driven competitive culture in the team which includes but is not limited to the following: 1\. Ensure that the Team is adequately staffed and resources have the right skills required for the job. Liaise with OADM, Accenture Leadership, Recruitment and IJP Teams on staffing requirements. 2\. Provide team members with a clear sense of direction and understanding of each other’s responsibilities including career planning and succession planning. 3\. Ensure a robust measurement system to substantiate performance evaluation of team members, recognizes and rewards individual and team accomplishments. 4\. Conduct/Support Training for regional teams and on\-board new team members on all areas of HRO operations and including: Controls \& Compliance, Business Continuity Plans, process analysis and customer service. 5\. Enhance team moral and engagement level thorough team bonding exercises and activities. Liaise with local PPA’s and Human Resources Team on driving key People initiatives. 6\. Ensure team is aware of their Goals and how their performance will be evaluated. Ensure that teams are able to explain the process. 7\. Escalation and resolution point for team members with regards to people related queries. Liaise with local Human Resources Team on critical issues. 8\. Communicates clearly and concisely, using appropriate level of detail, terminology and style. 9\. Retain talent and establish growth path for valued resources. Liaise with local Human Resources Team on critical issues. 10\. Resolve issues received via the escalation process and may assist with the researching and consulting to ensure client satisfaction in issue resolution. 11\. Lead or assist with the development of detailed analyses for area of responsibility 12\. Participate and potentially lead some activities/projects for area of responsibility 13\. May provide input to day\-to\-day management and reporting of specialist budget. 14\. Provide input to define standards and reusable approaches with benefit for cross\-functional groups 15\. Demonstrate strong customer service in all activities, setting the appropriate example for other members of the Team 16\. May supervise less experienced caseworkers and fill in for the manager as needed. 17\. May provide input into performance assessment of team members and provide coaching/counseling toward improving performance. 18\. May assist in creating annual team objectives. 19\. May participate in interview process for new hires into caseworker roles.


  

Any Graduation

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
description:
About Us:

Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities. **Come Join Our Team!*** As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
Job Summary:
* The Manager, Talent Acquisition (TA), plays a pivotal role in Ventra’s growth by effectively sourcing, attracting, and selecting top\-tier talent technology \& data department and Service Delivery leadership positions. The Assistant Manager, TA will support the Talent Acquisition team in all aspects from job requisition to candidate onboarding. The Manager, TA will collaborate closely with hiring managers, HR partners, and candidates to ensure a smooth and efficient recruitment process.


Essential Functions and Tasks:
**Job Requisition Management:*** Execute comprehensive TA strategies to identify and attract top for technology \& data and Service Delivery leadership positions.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to define job requirements and qualifications.
* Ensure job requisitions are posted on various job boards and Ventra career pages.
* Review and approve job descriptions for accuracy and compliance with Ventra guidelines.

**Candidate Sourcing****:*** Utilize various sourcing channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, and colleague referrals, to attract qualified candidates.
* Conduct initial resume screening and pre\-qualify candidates to ensure they meet the job requirements.

**Interview Coordination:*** Schedule interviews and coordinate communication between candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels.
* Prepare interview packages, including candidate resumes, interview questions, and assessment tools.

**Candidate Assessment:*** Administer and score candidate assessments as needed.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to evaluate candidate performance in interviews and assessments.

**Candidate Engagement:*** Maintain regular communication with candidates, keeping them informed of their status throughout the recruitment process.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience by addressing candidate inquiries and concerns.

**Offer and Onboarding Support:*** Assist in the preparation and negotiation of job offers.
* Coordinate the pre\-employment screening process, reference checks, and new hire paperwork.

**Reporting** **and Automation****:*** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records in the applicant tracking system (ATS).
* Generate and present weekly reports and metrics to the leadership team.
* Identity opportunities for process improvement and automation with the recruitment lifecycle.

**Compliance and Documentation:*** Stay abreast of industry trends, market conditions, and competitive intelligence to inform TA strategies and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with all employment laws and regulations in TA practices.
* Maintain thorough and organized TA documentation.

**Team Collaboration:*** Collaborate with the Talent Acquisition team to share the best practices, contribute to process improvement, and provide backup support as needed.

**New Hire Onboarding:*** Coordinate onboarding process and provide a comprehensive introduction to the company, policies, and culture.
* Ensure a smooth and welcoming onboarding experience for new colleagues.


Education and Experience Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Seven to nine (7\-9\) years of experience in talent acquisition, recruiting, or HR, with a focus on TA for technology/data and Service Delivery leadership positions.
* Proven track record of successfully sourcing and hiring top technical talent in a fast\-paced organization.
* Deep understanding of technology and IT concepts, terminology, and skill sets.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
* Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other HR software.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Well\-versed in employment laws and regulations.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* High level of professionalism and confidentiality.
* Knowledge of industry best practices in recruitment and talent acquisition.
* Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Basic use of computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.


Compensation:
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons.
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus in accordance with company policies.


Ventra Health:

Ventra Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culturally diverse organization. We strive for inclusiveness and a workplace where mutual respect is paramount. We encourage applications from a diverse pool of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, or veteran status. We will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, as needed, to assist them in performing essential job functions.

Ventra Health does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Ventra Health is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.  

  

**Solicitation of Payment**

Please be aware that there have been reports of individuals falsely claiming to represent Ventra Health or one of our affiliated entities Ventra Health Private Limited and Ventra Health Global Services. To protect yourself, verify any communication you receive by contacting us directly through our official channels. title: Manager, Employee Relations
description:
About Us: Imagine Your Future with Us! Since 1971, Paychex has been at the forefront of simplifying HR, payroll, and benefits for American businesses. Our digital HR technology and advisory solutions cater to the changing needs of employers and their employees. With our award\-winning training and endless opportunities for growth and development, you can build a lifelong career with us. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive and innovative culture. Our leaders are here to support your career journey; they and our dedicated employees embody the values that drive us to support each other, our clients, and our communities. Join us to pursue your passion and unleash your potential. Overview:

Lead a team of employee relations professionals responsible for responding to concerns, workplace policies, procedures and compliance with all company and external requirements. Contribute to productivity, motivation, and morale, while instilling and maintaining our culture and values. Define and implement proactive employee relations strategies and initiatives, lead investigations, and develop rapid response plans as required. In addition, is responsible for the development, implementation and communication of human resources policies and procedures.
Responsibilities:
* Effectively handle the timely investigation and dispositioning of ER matters and provide guidance and advice to the HR community and key stakeholders on sensitive, complex scenarios.
* Lead HR Strategic Initiatives or team projects to drive improved business results through increased productivity, retention and engagement of the workforce
* Partner with Internal Audit to provide recommendations to leaders on appropriate actions and/or resolutions.
* Work with legal counsel as appropriate in policy and program development in response to federal, state and local legislative trends.
* Establish internal processes to ensure appropriate documentation standards, case assignment and capacity management, case audit and weekly ER case reporting.
* Deliver Innovative Solutions: Challenge the status quo and think outside the box to generate creative ways to scale ER programs, tools and resources that meet timelines and deliverables.
* Recruit, select, hire and evaluate performance of Employee Relations team to ensure all department objectives are being met. Coach and develop Employee Relations team for personal and corporate advancement through career development, training programs and other resources as required for professional advancement.
* Own the design, development and execution of company\-wide programs such as a Multi\-Tiered Employee relations functions and performance improvement center for driving performance.
* Identify evolving and unique ER challenges across the organization and utilize ER expertise to predict and mitigate risk. Develop and execute ER programs for the business. Advise, mentor and guide all levels of management around complex ER decisions. including business conduct, performance management, terminations, and HR policies.
* Identify opportunities to enhance the employee experience through process improvement and refinement of services; offer potential solutions to drive greater stakeholder satisfaction. Actively engage in change to drive successful execution.

The Senior Manager Information Security, Digital Forensics (DF) leads the DF Hyderabad team within Digital Forensics. This on site leader manages investigators, coordinates with the India office, and works closely with the Security Operations Center (SOC), Tier 2 Security Operations, Incident Response (IR), Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Human Resources (HR), and electronic discovery (eDiscovery) stakeholders. The role is leadership first in addition to performing investigations and eDiscovery. The successful candidate must have the technical judgment to guide investigations, review findings, challenge unsupported conclusions, protect evidence, and support high risk cyber, legal, and HR escalations. The role also guides workflows across EnCase, Nuix, Forensic Toolkit (FTK), Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, CrowdStrike Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), IBM QRadar Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Microsoft Office 365 (O365\), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and ServiceNow. This leader will also help mature automation, Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted analysis, and future agentic AI workflows in a controlled, human reviewed manner.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead the Hyderabad DF team, including coaching, performance reviews, career development, workload planning, timekeeping, holiday approvals, and day to day people leadership.
* Operate as the local DF leader for Hyderabad, partnering with the India office and Cybersecurity Operations while escalating high risk decisions at the right time.
* Manage the handoff relationships between DF and the SOC, Tier 2 Security Operations and IR, including triage, escalation, case priority and service expectations.
* Oversee investigations and support activities involving cyber incidents, insider risk, employee matters, eDiscovery, litigation hold, compliance requests, data exposure, unauthorized access, malware, phishing, ransomware, and suspected data exfiltration.
* Partner with Legal, HR, Compliance, Privacy, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Vulnerability Management Services (VMS), Penetration Testing, Cloud Engineering, Information Technology (IT), and business teams to scope, preserve, review, and report evidence.
* Maintain evidence handling standards for Hyderabad, including authorized scope, chain of custody, hashing, secure storage, encrypted media, access control, case notes, evidence transfer, and cloud based analysis.
* Maintain cloud and Software as a Service (SaaS) forensic readiness across O365 and AWS, preservation workflows, evidence handling and data analysis.
* Guide DF workflow maturity across EnCase, Nuix, FTK, Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, CrowdStrike EDR, IBM QRadar SIEM, O365, AWS, and ServiceNow.
* Advance responsible adoption of automation, AI assisted workflows, and future agentic AI capabilities with controls for approved data use, human review, source validation, audit logging, and least privilege access.
* Review investigation strategy, final reports, and stakeholder communications for accuracy, evidence defensibility, confidentiality, and appropriate language.
* Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), playbooks, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), cross training, tabletop exercises, and report quality review processes to support team growth and operational maturity.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Any degree and 12 to 17 years of information security, digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity operations, cyber investigations, eDiscovery, or related field experience
* Experience should include at least 3 years leading technical teams, managing technical workstreams, or operating as a site or regional leader in a global cybersecurity environment.

**Functional Skills:**

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Leadership of DFIR, cyber investigations, evidence handling, and sensitive Legal, HR, Compliance, and eDiscovery matters.
* Security operations escalation management with SOC, Tier 2 Security Operations, IR, CrowdStrike EDR, IBM QRadar SIEM, O365, AWS, and ServiceNow.
* Strong understanding of forensic defensibility, chain of custody, cloud and SaaS evidence, privacy aware investigation scope, litigation hold, and report quality.
* Experience improving investigation operations through automation, AI assisted analysis, scripting, queries, playbooks, metrics, or workflow design.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Hands on or oversight experience with EnCase, Nuix, FTK, Monolith Pro, Cellebrite, Microsoft Purview eDiscovery, AWS forensic workflows, and O365 evidence.
* Knowledge of identity investigation, insider risk, data movement, endpoint artifacts, mobile forensics, email evidence, and cloud log analysis.
* Experience creating regulated documents, SOPs, work instructions, evidence handling standards, tabletop exercises, and readiness playbooks.
* Experience with scripting and query languages such as Python, PowerShell, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Ariel Query Language (AQL), Structured Query Language (SQL), Sigma, or YARA in a regulated global enterprise, consulting, government, or law enforcement cyber environment.

**Professional Certifications:**

* One active cybersecurity, digital forensics, incident response, electronic discovery, cloud security, security leadership, mobile forensics, or forensic tool certification is required.
* Strongly preferred certifications include Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner (GCFE), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), EnCase Certified Examiner (EnCE), Certified Computer Examiner (CCE), Certified Forensic Computer Examiner (CFCE), Certified Hacking Forensic Investigator (CHFI), Cellebrite Certified Physical Analyst (CCPA), Cellebrite Certified Mobile Examiner (CCME), Nuix certification, FTK certification, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, or Microsoft security and compliance certification.
* Preferred profile includes one leadership or security management certification and one DFIR, incident response, eDiscovery, cloud, mobile, or tool\-specific certification.

**Soft Skills:**

* Highest ethics, confidentiality, and sound judgment when handling employee, legal, security, and business evidence.
* Strong leadership presence with ability to operate independently, make timely decisions, and know when to escalate.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams, India office stakeholders, global leadership, Legal, HR, Compliance, and Privacy.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the confidence to challenge unsupported conclusions, unclear scope, or improper requests.
* High attention to detail in evidence handling, case notes, report review, administrative work, and stakeholder updates.

Als Sales \& Recruitment Meewerkstagiair ben je vanaf dag één onderdeel van ons team. Je ondersteunt bij het onderhouden van klantrelaties, het werven van technisch talent en het maken van de juiste match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers.


Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig werkzaamheden op te pakken en leert hoe sales en recruitment elkaar versterken binnen de technische arbeidsbemiddeling. Geen dag is hetzelfde en je krijgt een goed beeld van het volledige proces: van het vinden van kandidaten tot het opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties.


Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen en jouw ideeën uit te werken. Natuurlijk word je hierbij intensief begeleid door ervaren collega’s die jou helpen om het beste uit jezelf te halen.

Jij bent enthousiast, sociaal en ondernemend. Je vindt het leuk om met mensen in contact te zijn, bent nieuwsgierig en ziet kansen. Je durft initiatief te nemen, schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en wilt jezelf ontwikkelen binnen zowel sales als recruitment.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - LLM Routing & Cost Optimization
description:
We're looking for someone genuinely strong on **Google Cloud Platform** \- not necessarily years of work experience, but real depth: you've built things on GCP, you understand its IAM, quota, and networking model cold, and you can reason about Cloud Run, Vertex AI, and multi\-project setups from first principles. You'll design and build Zeqo's **multi\-provider LLM router** \- the internal system that decides which model/provider handles each request (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, and self\-hosted open\-weight models), optimizes for cost/latency/quality, and aggressively reduces redundant token spend through prompt caching and smart request management. This is a foundational infrastructure role: get it right and every downstream product gets faster and cheaper automatically.

This is intentionally open to early\-career engineers — we care far more about depth of GCP knowledge and evidence of things you've actually built than a resume with years on it.

***Location: Fully Remote***

What You'll Do

* **Design and build a unified LLM router** that abstracts Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and self\-hosted model endpoints behind a single internal API, so product teams never hardcode a provider.
* **Implement intelligent routing logic** — route by task type, cost ceiling, latency budget, context length, or model capability (e.g., OCR evaluation vs. conversational tutoring vs. embedding generation).
* **Build fallback and failover chains** so a rate limit, timeout, or outage on one provider automatically retries on another without breaking the user experience.
* **Design prompt/response caching** (semantic and exact\-match) to cut redundant token usage and reduce rate\-limit pressure — particularly for repeated question\-bank queries, common doubt patterns in Mophy, and OCR grading rubrics.
* **Own rate\-limit and quota management** across providers and GCP projects, including request queuing, backpressure, and graceful degradation under load.
* **Build cost observability**: per\-request cost attribution, per\-product/per\-school cost dashboards, and alerting on spend anomalies.
* **Benchmark providers and models** on cost, latency, and quality for Zeqo's specific workloads (OCR grading, RAG retrieval via Mophy, test generation) and recommend routing policy changes.
* **Collaborate with the ML/infra work already in flight** — our self\-hosted BGE\-large\-en\-v1\.5 embedding service on Cloud Run, GCP multi\-project quota isolation, and DPO training data pipelines — and integrate the router cleanly into that architecture.

What We're Looking For

* **0–2 years of experience** — this is deliberately open to freshers and early\-career engineers. What matters is depth, not tenure.
* **Real GCP depth**, demonstrated through projects, coursework, certifications, or personal builds: Cloud Run, IAM, service accounts, multi\-project/quota architecture, Vertex AI. A GCP certification (Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) is a strong plus but not required if you can show equivalent hands\-on work.
* Solid backend fundamentals — API design, working with external APIs, basic distributed\-systems thinking (retries, timeouts, rate limits).
* Comfort with or eagerness to learn caching strategies (Redis or similar); exposure to LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) is a plus but not a hard requirement — we'll teach you the LLM\-specific parts.
* A cost\-conscious, first\-principles mindset — you enjoy understanding *why* a system is expensive or slow, not just making it work.
* Startup mindset: comfortable figuring things out with a small team, moving fast, and owning a system end\-to\-end even without a large playbook to follow.
* Bonus: personal projects or coursework touching RAG, embeddings, or prompt engineering.

To Apply

Send your resume and any GCP\-related projects (GitHub, coursework, certifications, personal builds — anything that shows depth) to **hello@zeqo.in** or WhatsApp **\+91\-9136734595**. We'd rather see a GCP project you built and can explain in detail than a polished resume with no substance behind it.

Along with your resume, please answer these three questions:

* **Describe a GCP project or setup you've built (personal, academic, or professional).** What service(s) did you use, and what was the trickiest problem you had to solve?
* **If an API you're calling suddenly starts rate\-limiting you mid\-request, what's your first instinct for handling it?** (No wrong answers — we want to see how you think about this.)
* **What's one thing about cloud costs (GCP or otherwise) that you think most engineers get wrong or don't think about enough?**

title: Security Engineer, AWS Security Incident Response
description:
**Description**
 AWS Security Incident Response is looking for technical Security Engineers that are passionate about learning new concepts and work well within a team environment to keep customers secure. We value engineers that can work through ambiguity to identify suspicious activity, lead security response, and can explain technical security concepts to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 AWS Services provides developers and small to large businesses access to the horizontally scalable state of the art cloud infrastructure like S3, EC2, AMI, Cloud Front and Simple DB, that powers Amazon.com. Developers can build any type of business on AWS Platform and scale their application with growing business needs. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to threat findings that indicate unauthorized activity has occurred
* Identify, evaluate and communicate security threats, risks and vulnerabilities, and propose recommended remediation for security issues.
* Contribute to the development of security automation and security posture improvements.
* Track and report on the effectiveness of AWS detective controls such as Amazon GuardDuty and partner products such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Wiz Defend
* Develop processes and policies to increase security response effectiveness.
* On\-call support: This role requires periodic on\-call responsibilities including weekends.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Security Engineer in AWS Security Incident Response, your responsibilities include monitoring networks and systems for potential threats, performing triage for security alerts, documenting suspicious activity, and reporting issues so they can be adequately handled. You will work alongside our security engineers and partner teams to perform daily threat detection and incident response, using the full capability of AWS technologies and services to detect and mitigate cyber threats at a massive scale and help protect AWS Customers. You should also enjoy learning about the most up\-to\-date new technologies and procedures to protect information systems and data.
   

  

**About The Team**
 AWS Security Incident Response provides 24/7 threat monitoring, investigation, and response across for customer’s AWS environments. The service enhances existing security capabilities by providing security monitoring for all native AWS services and supports vendor agnostic detective and protective controls to provide holistic security controls for customers. This is done by leveraging data on common attack techniques to enhance detective controls and incident response, then building auto\-remediation capabilities to minimize disruption to customer workloads. When a security event does happen, you will be there provide guidance.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language experience
* 2\+ years of scripting, programming, and security code review in a common programming language (non\-internship) experience
* 2\+ years of troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non\-internship) experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Knowledge of industry\-based security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques
* Experience in scripting, programming, and security code reviewing in a common programming language (non\-internship)
* Experience in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating basic tasks using command line tools (non\-internship experience)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of any combination of the following: threat modeling experience, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security experience
* 2\+ years of scripting, programming, or security code review in a common language, such as Python, Java or C\+\+ experience
* Knowledge of command line tools to troubleshoot protocols, analyze log outputs, or automate basic tasks
* Knowledge of networking protocols, to include HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience in scripting, programming, or security code reviewing in a common language, such as Python, Java, or C\+\+
* Experience performing security activities across one or more phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), such as security design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Support Professional who may be deployed at partner schools to manage and maintain academic and administrative data using our School Management ERP system.

The primary responsibility of this role is accurate, timely, and structured handling of school data. Along with data services, the role is intentionally designed to help professionals develop strong communication, presentation, and professional interaction skills through guided exposure to service explanation, demonstrations, and supervised sales presentations.

This is a service\-first role with communication practice embedded into the work, not a target\-driven sales job.

Key ResponsibilitiesA. Core Data Support Responsibilities (Primary Focus)

* Manage and maintain school data using the School Management ERP, including:
* Student records
* Attendance and academic data
* Fee and administrative information
* Teacher and class\-related data
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality
* Perform regular data verification, updates, and reports as required by the school
* Assist school staff in understanding and correctly using ERP features
* Act as the single point of contact for ERP\-related data support at the school

B. Communication \& Service Presentation Responsibilities (Skill\-Building Focus)

* Clearly explain ERP features and benefits to school staff when required
* Assist in product walkthroughs, demos, and presentations under guidance
* Support senior team members during school meetings, service reviews, and discussions
* Learn to present:
* How data services improve school efficiency
* How ERP supports academics and administration
* Gradually participate in service pitching activities as part of professional development

Managing school data requires regular interaction with teachers, coordinators, and administrators

* Clear communication ensures:
* Correct data input
* Better adoption of the ERP system
* Trust and long\-term service relationships
* Sales presentations are used as a structured training ground to practice:
* Professional speaking
* Logical explanation
* Confidence building
* Real\-world communication skills

We believe communication is a skill that improves only through practice, and this role provides a safe, guided environment to learn it.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Basic computer proficiency (Excel, data entry, ERP systems preferred)
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Willingness to learn and follow structured processes
* Basic verbal communication skills (fluency improves with practice)
* Comfort in interacting with school staff and professionals
* Positive attitude towards learning presentation and communication skills

Preferred (Not Mandatory)

* Prior experience in:
* Data entry
* School administration
* ERP or MIS systems
* Interest in professional growth beyond a desk\-based role

Training \& Support Provided

* Complete training on the School Management ERP
* Step\-by\-step guidance on data handling processes
* Communication and presentation coaching
* Supervised exposure to service demos and sales discussions
* Continuous feedback and improvement support

Career Growth Path

* Senior Data Support Specialist
* School ERP Consultant
* Service Implementation Lead

Who Should Apply

This role is ideal for candidates who:

* Freshers may apply
* Want a stable, skill\-based professional role
* Are interested in data, systems, and structured work
* Want to improve communication skills through real\-life practice
* Prefer learning by doing rather than classroom\-only training

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Operations Staff (MSH)
description:
**Job Title** **Operations****Staff** **Function** **Operations** **Reports To**  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable) **Location** **Branch / Service Centre / Hub / Warehouse / PUD (Location Agnostic)** **Travel Required** **25%****þ****50%****75%**  



**About****DHL****Blue Dart Express India:****Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

**Position Overview****:**
The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.

**Job Purpose****:**
To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.

 **Key****Roles \& Responsibilities****:****Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.
 **Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.
 **Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.
 **Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.
 **Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.
 **Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.
 **Qualifications \& Experience:****Education**:* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.
 **Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.
 **Eligibility Requirements****:*** Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.
 **Skills \& Capabilities:****Technical Skills:*** Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding
 **Key Competencies:*** Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance
**Key Performance Indicators:** **KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning

 **Why join****DHL****Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Office Administrator
description:
The DesignBOX is looking for someone who can become the operational backbone of our office.

**This is not a role where you wait for instructions all day. We need someone who notices what needs to be done, follows up without being reminded, keeps information organised and ensures the office continues to function smoothly even when the founders are not physically present.**

You will work closely with the partners and act as a link between the founders, the team, vendors, contractors and other external stakeholders.

The role combines office administration, executive assistance, basic accounts coordination, team follow\-ups and calendar management. The work itself is not complicated, but it requires consistency, discipline, common sense and a strong sense of responsibility.

***What You Will Be Responsible ForOffice and Team Coordination***

* Manage the day\-to\-day functioning of the office.
* Maintain staff attendance, leave records and basic administrative documentation.
* Take regular work updates from team members and share clear, concise summaries with the partners.
