**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary :**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

title: Network Engineer II, Just Walk Out Tech
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Amazon Physical Stores is a store with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers use the Amazon Physical Stores app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go! Check it out at amazon.com/go.
   

  

 Our approach to problems is entrepreneurial. You will be challenged to invent, create and solve challenging problems as well as wear many hats and collaborate in an environment that's more startup than big company. You will need a strong ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues.
   

  

 As a Network Support Engineer, you seek resolution to Networking problems and mitigate risk, always ensuring a Customer Obsessed experience has occurred. You will be working on services with a direct impact on the customer experience. If you are excited about the opportunity to learn and work on networks, distributed systems, enjoy trouble shooting and solving complex problems, consider the opportunities to work with Amazon Physical Stores and the Just Walk Out Technology.
   

  

 You will help solve a variety of challenges and offer your expertise in growing the knowledge of your peers via team collaboration. We consistently whiteboard so be comfortable writing and supporting your ideas on the team board. You will play an active role in defining the support processes for technologies in partnership with other technology leaders within and possibly outside the team. You should be comfortable with a level of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving big challenges. You will also mentor other engineers in your area of expertise. Along the way, we guarantee that you'll work hard, have fun and impact many customers!
   

  

 This role requires the flexibility to work 5 days a week (including Weekends) in the 24/7 model support in shift.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting and experience with network troubleshooting tools (telnet, test\-netconnection, tracert, tracetcp, iperf, ntttcp, dig, and packet capture tools)
* Experience working with networking fundamentals or Internet protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, SSL, DNS, HTTP/S, or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of network administration experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in major internet routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
* Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Experience in automation via Bash/shell scripting and Perl/Python programming
* Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic, results\-driven **Pharmaceutical Sales Executive** to spearhead our business growth and brand expansion in the Bhopal territory. In this role, you will act as the vital link between our company and healthcare professionals. You will not just be selling products; you will be building strategic partnerships with doctors, specialists, and healthcare institutions to ensure our medications reach the patients who need them most.

* **Headquarter (HQ):** Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
* **Territory Coverage:** Bhopal, Sehore, Vidisha, Raisen Mandideep and Hoshangabad(Narmadapuram), etc.

**Core Responsibilities \& Duties1\. Product Promotion \& Clinical Detailing**

* Schedule and conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings with doctors, consultants, and specialists across major hospitals and private clinics.
* Deliver high\-impact, scientific presentations (detailing) to healthcare professionals, explaining drug efficacy, safety profiles, dosage regimens, and patient benefits.
* Stay continuously updated on medical literature, clinical trials, and competitor product updates to answer complex medical queries confidently.

**2\. Territory \& Business Development**

* Strategically map and analyze the assigned territory in Bhopal to identify high\-potential clinics, healthcare hubs, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
* Formulate and execute daily/weekly route plans to maximize field coverage, ensure consistent touchpoints, and minimize travel fatigue.

**3\. Chemist \& Stockist Channel Management**

* Coordinate closely with local stockists and distributors to ensure seamless supply chain management and zero product stock\-outs.
* Visit retail pharmacies and chemists regularly to monitor prescription generation trends, track competitor movement, and secure product availability.
* Manage commercial terms, booking orders, and ensuring timely collections from the distribution channel.

**4\. Market Intelligence \& Competitor Analysis**

* Act as the eyes and ears of the company on the ground. Monitor and report on competitor activities, pricing strategies, new launches, and marketing tactics.
* Identify unmet clinical needs in the territory and share actionable feedback with the internal product management and marketing teams.

**5\. Compliance, Organizing Events \& CRM Operations**

* Organize clinical meetings, round\-table discussions, and medical seminars for doctors to foster scientific engagement and brand loyalty.
* Maintain rigorous data hygiene by tracking all daily field activities, doctor call metrics, and feedback into the company’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tracking tool.
* Ensure absolute compliance with pharmaceutical marketing ethics, guidelines, and corporate compliance frameworks.

**Required Qualifications \& Key Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm), Science (B.Sc.), or a related field. An MBA in Marketing/Pharma Management is a plus.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of proven experience in pharmaceutical sales or healthcare field sales. High\-potential science freshers with exceptional communication skills may also be considered.

* **Core Competencies:** Strong scientific aptitude, persuasive communication, excellent negotiation skills, resilience, and a high emotional quotient (EQ).
* **Logistics:** Must own a reliable two\-wheeler, possess a valid driving license, and be comfortable with extensive local daily field travel.

**What We Offer**

* A competitive compensation package based on experience and expertise.
* Clear, performance\-linked monthly/quarterly incentives based on target achievements.
* Strong career progression pathways to upgrade into Area Sales Manager (ASM) roles.

Evolvx Labs  
https://evolvxlabs.com/

Evolvx Labs is looking for a driven, problem\-solving AI Developer to help us design and build intelligent systems that redefine how modern businesses operate. We specialize in custom AI solutions, LLM\-powered tools, and enterprise automation—and we need someone who can turn complex ideas into scalable, real\-world applications.

If you are passionate about artificial intelligence, building products, and working in a fast\-moving startup environment, this role puts you right at the center of innovation.

The Role

As an AI Developer, you won’t just be writing code. You’ll be building systems that solve real business problems using cutting\-edge AI technologies. A major part of your role will involve developing **custom ERP systems** tailored to specific business workflows.

Key Responsibilities

**Custom ERP Development:**  
Understand business operations (sales, inventory, finance, HR) and translate them into scalable ERP modules.

**Full\-Stack Development:**  
Build and manage both frontend and backend systems required for ERP platforms.

**Database Design:**  
Design efficient database structures, relationships, and queries for handling complex business data.

**AI Integration:**  
Embed AI capabilities such as LLM\-powered insights, automation, and smart workflows into ERP systems.

**API \& System Integration:**  
Integrate third\-party services (payments, CRMs, analytics tools) and ensure smooth data flow across systems.

**Workflow Automation:**  
Develop automation pipelines that reduce manual work across business processes.

**Scalability \& Performance:**  
Ensure systems are optimized for speed, reliability, and future scaling.

**Testing \& Debugging:**  
Identify issues, fix bugs, and maintain system stability across deployments.

**Continuous Improvement:**  
Refactor and improve systems based on user feedback and evolving business needs.

What We’re Looking For

**Technical Skills:**  
Basic understanding of programming (Python preferred), databases, and APIs. Exposure to full\-stack development is a plus.

**AI Curiosity:**  
You actively explore AI tools, LLMs, and automation.

**Problem\-Solving:**  
Ability to break down real\-world business problems into software solutions.

**Learning Mindset:**  
Fast learner who can adapt quickly in a startup environment.

**Ownership:**  
You take responsibility for what you build and care about the outcome.

Why Join Us?

**Path to Leadership:**  
High performers will have the opportunity to grow into leadership roles as the company scales.

**Core Team Exposure:**  
Work directly with the founding team and become part of the early core team shaping the company.

**High Learning Opportunity:**  
Hands\-on experience with real AI systems, ERP development, and live client projects.

**Startup Environment:**  
Fast\-paced, execution\-driven culture where your work actually matters.

**Hybrid Flexibility:**  
Work from our Kottayam base with flexibility when needed.

title: Global Mobility Delivery Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


You will lead a subteam within BCG’s global mobility delivery organization, overseeing the execution of geographic transfers for consulting staff while ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery across cases. In addition to your leadership responsibilities, you will act as a player\-coach, directly supporting more senior and high\-touch transfers and contributing to delivery excellence.

  

You will manage a team of delivery professionals based in India, providing direction, coaching, and support, while also maintaining your own case portfolio. You will work closely with the Global Mobility Delivery Director to ensure alignment on priorities, performance, and continuous improvement, while taking ownership of people management and day\-to\-day team leadership.

* Lead and develop a team of mobility delivery professionals, including goal setting, performance management, and ongoing coaching
* Ensure consistent, high\-quality execution of consulting team geographic transfers across the team, maintaining standards for accuracy, compliance with internal policies and external requirements, and stakeholder experience
* Support more senior and high\-touch mobility cases, including MDP transfers, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness while working closely with PSG and other stakeholders
* Manage a portfolio of transfers directly, acting as a primary point of contact for transferees and offices
* Ensure effective workload distribution and prioritization across the team, supporting scalability and sustainable team structure
* Drive adherence to established policies and processes, escalating complex or out\-of\-policy cases to Business Partnering as needed
* Collaborate with GM Operations \& Digital Enablement to ensure effective use of tools and systems and provide feedback to improve delivery processes
* Coordinate with vendors during case execution to support effective and consistent service delivery
* Contribute to delivery\-related projects and initiatives, acting as a resource to the Delivery Director to drive improvements
* Monitor team performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and consistency

  

What You'll Bring

* You bring solid experience in global mobility, HR operations, or a related field, with strong exposure to transferee\-facing delivery
* You have experience leading or mentoring others, with the ability to guide, develop, and support team members effectively
* You demonstrate strong ownership of delivery quality, ensuring consistent, high\-standard execution across cases
* You are comfortable balancing hands\-on execution with team leadership, operating effectively as a player\-coach
* You bring a strong focus on customer experience, ensuring transferees and stakeholders receive high\-quality, responsive support
* You have experience working in a global, cross\-cultural, and highly virtual environment, engaging effectively across geographies
* You demonstrate sound judgement in applying policies and frameworks, and know when to escalate complex or out\-of\-policy situations
* You are organized and able to manage multiple priorities across both your own work and team responsibilities
* You use data and performance insights to monitor team outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement
* Experience working with mobility tools and systems, including Assignment Pro, is a plus

  

Who You'll Work With


You’ll work closely with the Global Mobility Delivery Director and your team of delivery professionals based in India to ensure consistent, high\-quality execution of mobility cases. You will act as a key link between the Director and the team, providing day\-to\-day leadership and ensuring alignment on priorities and ways of working.

  

You will collaborate with GM Business Partnering to align on policy and escalate complex cases, and with GM Operations \& Digital Enablement to ensure effective use of tools, systems, and processes. You will also interact regularly with transferees, home and host offices, PSG, and vendors, ensuring a smooth and high\-quality experience across the mobility lifecycle.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Full Lifecycle Recruiter-I, Amazon University Talent Acquisition
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The recruiter will be responsible for all levels of talent acquisition, recruiting, and recruitment programs, procedures, and plans. Serve as consultant and partner staying current on business and market trends, assisting on both the strategic and tactical level. Possesses strong understanding of client needs and hiring conditions external and internal. Provides advice, expertise and assistance to all levels of personnel both internal and external on various recruiting/talent acquisition related issues. Serves as trusted member of Global HR organization driving great partnerships with internal \& external customers. Provides sourcing and candidate generation to hiring managers across multiple teams, organizations and locations. To be great in this role the candidate must be able to successfully manage, prioritize and close searches against a timeline and have experience setting benchmarks, metrics, and understand how to prioritize to hit all customer SLAs. They thrive in an innovative, fast\-paced environment, can roll up their sleeves, work hard, have fun, and get the job done.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with hiring teams to build effective sourcing, assessment, and closing approaches with an ability to manage customer/partner expectations through a deep understanding of return on investment.
* Be able to recruit passive candidates and possess the mentality to "profile people and gauge chemistry of candidates for fit and understand their motivation" rather than sell a role.
* Possess strong ability to screen interview candidates within the framework of the position specifications and prepare an ideal candidate slate within an appropriate and consistent timeline.
* Build and maintain network of potential candidates through pro\-active market research and on\-going relationship management; conducts in\-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate hiring manager preferences through high offer\-to\-interview ratios.
* Communicate effectively with the hiring manager and interview team to ensure preparedness during the interview process. Share and exchange information with all levels of management.
* Recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long\-range growth of the company, implementing any new processes and fine\-tuning standard processes for recruiting that fits within Amazon's mission to deliver the highest quality results to the customer.
* Provide a great candidate experience and act as a candidate advocate.
* Articulate in writing a plan with deliverable, timelines and a formal tracking process.
* Participate in special projects/recruiting initiatives including assessment of best practices in interviewing techniques, leveraging of internal sources of talent and identification of top performers for senior\-level openings.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Ability to source Business/tech talent, with prior experience to hire for roles like Product, Program, Sales, Tech Engineering and senior leadership roles
* 2\+ years of Experience in campus hiring or university recruitment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Analytical skills with ability to create, measure, and scale the right workflow between candidates, hiring managers, and the recruiting team.
* Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, as a team leader and member.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Training

 Assistant Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurugram
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Senior Manager \- Training
   

  

**About The Function**
 MakeMyTrip’s Hotels business is one of the largest and fastest\-growing verticals within the organization, offering a diverse portfolio of accommodations across domestic and international destinations. With a network of 70,000\+ contracted properties , the business spans everything from budget\-friendly stays to premium and experiential hotels, catering to a wide range of traveller needs and serving millions of customers each year.
   

  

 Within this business, the Training team serves as a key enabler of scale and execution. The team drives capability building across stakeholders by strengthening product understanding, process excellence, service quality, and platform adoption. Through structured learning interventions and continuous upskilling, the Training function helps translate business priorities into consistent on\-ground execution and improved customer outcomes across the Hotels ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role is responsible for end\-to\-end training management and content creation for the Hotels business, combining Learning \& Development, content development, and marketing communication to enable internal teams and partner ecosystems.
   

  

 It involves designing and delivering effective training programs alongside creating engaging communication and learning assets that drive awareness, adoption, and capability building. With a strong focus on clarity, engagement, and scale, the role translates business priorities into structured learning interventions and impactful communication that support consistent execution and performance across the Hotels ecosystem.
   

  

 What Will You Be Doing
   

  

* Training Program Design \& Execution


 Design and deliver structured skill development programs, role\-based trainings, refresher sessions, and continuous learning interventions aligned with evolving business needs and priorities.
   

  

* Content Development


 Develop high\-impact learning content including presentations, facilitator guides, videos, e\-learning modules, promotional videos, and job aids that support effective knowledge transfer and adoption.
   

  

* Communication Design \& Campaign Management


 Own end\-to\-end creation of partner\-facing communication assets such as emails, flyers, banners, videos, and digital creatives aligned to business objectives. Plan and execute multi\-channel communication campaigns to support product launches and key initiatives.
   

  

* Learning Communication \& Enablement


 Create learning\-focused communication and marketing assets including newsletters, launch decks, mailers, videos, FAQs, and playbooks to reinforce training programs and enable consistent execution.
   

  

* Training Facilitation


 Deliver engaging classroom, virtual, and hybrid training sessions for internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring high levels of participation, clarity, and impact.
   

  

* Community \& Engagement Management


 Build and manage internal and external learning communities or social platforms to drive engagement, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
   

  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


 Partner closely with business, sales, operations, product, and HR teams to identify capability gaps and design targeted learning and enablement interventions.
   

  

* Training Effectiveness \& Continuous Improvement


 Track training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics, using insights to continuously refine content, delivery, and overall learning outcomes.
   

  

 Qualification \& Experience
   

  

* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience across training, learning \& development, content creation, and communication roles.
* Exposure to sales, operations, partner enablement, or capability development environments preferred.
* Experience in e\-commerce, internet, FMCG, hospitality, or service\-oriented organizations is an added advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clear, engaging, and audience\-relevant content.
* Hands\-on experience with content creation tools, presentations, and digital learning platforms.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms and digital content best practices preferred


 Key Success Factors Of The Role
   

  

* Ability to translate business needs into practical, effective training and communication solutions.
* High level of ownership and accountability , with the ability to operate independently and drive outcomes end to end.
* Strong storytelling and content design capability, with a sharp eye for clarity, engagement, and impact.
* Effective stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills across business and support teams.
* Creative mindset balanced with structured thinking and disciplined execution.
* Agility to thrive in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 HR Operations Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Why Rolls\-Royce?**
 At Rolls\-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.
   

  

 By joining Rolls\-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world\-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high\-performance culture.
   

  

**Summary**
 Support the delivery of Operational GBS People Services within a regional scope of the India centre. Providing operational expertise in delivering People services to employees to specified centre. To drive ongoing transformation improvement of the service aligned to the developing needs of the Rolls\-Royce businesses.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Accountable for operational service delivery and performance for regional processes in scope of the People Services organisation.
* Manage key business relationships and stakeholders in delivery of core People Services.
* Lead and direct a team of Team Leads and service delivery Teams in providing excellent customer service and maintaining quality of service. This will also include customer service \& deliverables of outsourced vendors.
* Manage activities to ensure compliance and adherence to group policies, region/country legislation/requirements, procedures and management of risks.
* Work closely with process owners to manage change control and deploy into operational service.
* Provide operational reporting, metrics and KPI’s internally to the team to drive ownership and performance and to key customers to demonstrate service performance and customer satisfaction.


**Qualifications**
* 15\+ years’ experience of HR service delivery.
* Proven excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Knowledge and expertise of leading and supporting teams in a large\-scale HR service operations environment, preferable knowledge of payroll.
* Good understanding of lean process management and continuous improvement methodologies
* Expertise and knowledge of customer service protocols and technologies in relation to HR service operations
* Experience in insourcing of HR processes from a third\-party vendor
* Strong Experience in Service Management and delivery of Service Excellence


 Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi\-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls\-Royce into a high\-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.
   

  

 Rolls\-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non\-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.
   

  

 As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.
   

  

**Job Category**
 Human Resources

title: People Operations Business Partner -SAAS -CTC upto 30 LPA
description:
In this role, you will help channel information, which will allow People Partners and business leaders to have the information required to make excellent decisions, which will, in turn, help create a great working environment for our remote, global team. You'll be essential in advancing a more diverse, accessible, equitable, and inclusive team through our onboarding, growth, engagement, retention, and inclusion practices.
 



  





**Responsibilities:\-**




  





**Onboarding \& Offboarding** 



* Own end\-to\-end onboarding — culture walkthroughs, asset/access provisioning, BGV in partnership with vendors.
* Automate onboarding workflows (offer letters, welcome packs, Day 1 checklists) via AI tools and HRIS integrations. \[Non\-negotiable]
* Manage offboarding end\-to\-end — exit interviews, knowledge transfer, system access revocation.



  





**People Partnering** 



* Partner with leaders on people\-related conflicts, decisions, and concerns.
* SPOC for team queries on policies, culture, and HR processes.
* Run periodic check\-ins to gauge productivity, flag risks, and support retention.
* Strategize and execute online and offline engagement activities end\-to\-end.



  





**Policy, Compliance \& Documentation** 



* Own all People Ops communications — templates, policies, announcements, handbook entries.
* Vet HR\-related paperwork and contracts; issue letters and documents within TATs.
* Partner with leaders to build policies aligned to company's vision and values.



  





**AI\-Powered HR Operations** 



* Identify and eliminate manual HR processes using AI and automation tools (Claude, Zapier, or similar). \[Non\-negotiable]
* Build and maintain automated dashboards for headcount, attrition, engagement, and compliance. \[Non\-negotiable]
* Default to automation\-first when designing or inheriting any HR process
 **.**



  





**Retention, Performance \& Vendor Management** 



* Strategize and execute attrition reduction and retention programs.
* Support performance review cycles — data aggregation, manager briefing docs, completion nudges.
* Negotiate and manage vendor partnerships — insurance, BGV, POSH, legal, compliance, swag.
* Coordinate payroll changes with Finance within agreed TATs; manage offsites and workations end\-to\-end.



  





**About You:** 




**Experience** 



* 5–12years in People Operations or HRBP roles.
* Experience in a remote, global team of 200\+ people preferred.
* Degree in HR, Psychology, Business, or a related field.
* Knowledge of labour laws and employee relations across geographie
* Comfortable extracting and structuring HRIS/ATS data exports for reporting or AI\-assisted processing.
* Experience using AI for document generation, policy drafting, and communications at scale.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets — pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, data validation.
* Able to independently build people dashboards from raw HRIS/payroll exports.

title: Manager, HR Business Partner
description:
The Manager, HRBP is responsible for planning and executing HR Programs and strategies to support the needs of ILM through collaboration with stakeholders, HR specialist groups and other HR business partners. This role will support a client group within ILM and partner closely with other HRBP’s. They will serve as an expert consultant to production leaders on talent matters, including organizational design and leader effectiveness, talent and change management, learning needs/opportunities, DEI and employee engagement!
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Establishes and maintains deep understanding of the client organizations and business, in the interest of building effective and productive working relationships with internal partners and clients.
* Handling Employee Relations/ Grievance Handling, Performance Management, Talent Planning/ Development, and partnering with Global Compensation/Operations teams
* Emphasize a consultative approach, requiring the ability to quickly understand the business, anticipate needs, and provide solutions to business priorities
* Handle key HR projects across all client groups.
* Explicitly requires strong organizational and process management skills and the ability to function in a matrixed co\-leadership environment.
* Coach production leaders on HR policies, processes and management issues, including talent planning, learning and development, employee inclusion and engagement, and performance management to promote a culture of continuous growth and development.
* Assists in designing and implementing HR solutions to business strategies, initiatives and challenges
* Partners with the compensation team to lead pay for performance programs including annual merit review, bonus, promotions and out of cycle requests.
* Partner with Talent Management and Training to assess talent capabilities and development needs based on business strategy.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 8\+ years of experiences as a Human Resources manager in any areas of organization development, talent acquisitions, talent development, ER, and compensation and benefits with Min. 3 years of HRBP experiences supporting multiple client groups.
* Experience working with senior executives in an “influence without authority” role
* Ability to perform with a “roll\-up your sleeves” attitude, equally adept at thinking strategically and operationally
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage ambiguity – dealing with issues that do not always have a process or a system in place, and potentially with conflicting priorities and/or perspectives.
* Strong business sense with a keen ability to quickly digest new information.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills.
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to details.
* Ability to gain trust and work effectively across multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to identify the best solution and outcome for the organization and to balance between business partnership and employee advocacy.
* Proactive, self\-starter who can deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


**Education**
* A Masters degree in Human Resource Management will be preferred.

title: HR Assistant II
description:
**Summary:**



 This role involves supporting day\-to\-day operations by maintaining constant communication with site operations, senior leadership, content team, technology teams, and other internal clients on the status of real\-time metrics. The position requires a working knowledge of real\-time monitoring in a call center environment, with a focus on service level (SL), volume metrics, and occupancy management.
 




**Responsibilities:**
* Maintain real\-time monitoring in the call center environment, focusing on SL, volume offered/incoming/handled, outsourcing percentages, and email backlog sizes.
* Write root cause analysis for any service failures.
* Identify irregularities affecting SL and candidate experience, notify vendor partners, and advise on required mitigation actions.
* Conduct timely discovery and escalation of outages, performing troubleshooting steps to identify affected parties and impact.
* Understand queues/routing profiles and perform skill blending and profile modification as needed.
* Set up Priority Queue (PQ), Visibility Threshold (VT), and Preserve Avail (PA) based on SL and occupancy performance.
* Manage occupancy, including VTO decisions and NPT approvals.
* Manage AUX states/non\-adherence and escalate to corresponding Planning \& Vendor teams.
* Conduct intraday reporting, including call\-outs.
* Review existing SOPs and prepare new SOPs to document learnings from incidents and daily events.
* Display effective communication, capable of summarizing daily performance and handling leadership queries with appropriate RCA.
* Manage user profiles in terms of onboarding, offboarding, access management, and reconciliation.


**Requirements:**
* 6 months of customer service experience.
* 6 months of experience with Microsoft Office products and applications.


**Required Skills:**
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and summarize performance metrics.


**Preferred Skills:**
* 1 year of customer service experience.
* 1 year of workforce management (real\-time monitoring) experience in a call center environment.
* 1 year of experience with Microsoft Office products and applications.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About**
**About Milliman**
 Milliman is among the world's largest providers of actuarial and related products and services. The firm has consulting practices in healthcare, property \& casualty insurance, life insurance and financial services, and employee benefits. Founded in 1947, Milliman is an independent firm with offices in major cities around the globe.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Data Engineer will support data ingestion, transformation, profiling, documentation, and Microsoft Fabric environment operations for a data and actuarial discovery sandbox. This role will work closely with senior data engineering, actuarial, product, IT, and security teams to help build reliable data pipelines, maintain Lakehouse tables, validate data quality, and support controlled access to curated datasets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support ingestion of sample source data from cloud storage into Microsoft Fabric using ADF pipelines, OneLake landing folders, and Lakehouse tables.
* Assist with the creation and maintenance of bronze, silver, and gold tables based on the agreed discovery data model.
* Build and run data profiling scripts and notebooks to identify file structures, schemas, row counts, null rates, duplicate records, timestamp ranges, and field\-level quality issues.
* Help standardize common source data fields such as entity identifiers, transaction or event IDs, timestamps, event types, measurement units, and geography fields.
* Support data transformation work required to prepare daily summary, event\-summary, exposure, behavioral, and contextual feature datasets.
* Document source tables, transformations, assumptions, data quality findings, known limitations, and operational procedures for actuarial users.
* Support ad hoc data requests from the actuarial team during discovery and help refine datasets based on feedback.
* Assist with Microsoft Fabric workspace setup, Lakehouse configuration, pipeline permissions, access controls, and environment support.
* Help configure and validate secure connections between Microsoft Fabric and external cloud platforms, including authentication handling, service account/key usage, and privileged access management considerations.
* Monitor pipeline runs, ingestion failures, storage usage, compute activity, and basic cost/performance indicators during the discovery build.
* Provide crossover support to the product build effort, including Fabric configuration, Lakehouse setup, Power BI access support, and troubleshooting with IT/security teams.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Foundational experience in data engineering, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data transformation, or cloud data platforms.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Python; exposure to Spark, notebooks, or distributed data processing is preferred.
* Basic understanding of data modeling, data quality checks, schema validation, and table maintenance.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, ADF pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse tables, or similar cloud data services.
* Ability to analyze source data, identify quality issues, and document findings clearly for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively with senior engineers and actuarial stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to insurance, actuarial, mobility, operational, or risk analytics data.
* Experience working with GCP, Azure, Power BI, or cloud\-to\-cloud data ingestion patterns.
* Understanding of access controls, workspace permissions, data retention, and secure data handling practices.
* Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, or similar tools for version control, task tracking, and documentation.

title: Digital Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
 Data Engineers with hands\-on expertise in PySpark and Fivetran to design, build, and maintain scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines, at two levels: Junior (execution\-focused, guided work) and Senior (ownership of architecture, performance, and mentoring). Both levels will work on integrating data from SaaS, database, and API sources into the cloud data warehouse, and building distributed processing jobs to support analytics and reporting.
   

  

**Junior Data Engineer — Requirements**
* \[Must\-Have] 1–3 years of hands\-on experience with PySpark (DataFrames, Spark SQL basics) — production or strong academic/project experience acceptable.
* \[Must\-Have] Working knowledge of Fivetran or a similar ELT tool (Airbyte, Stitch) — setting up connectors, monitoring syncs.
* \[Must\-Have] Solid SQL fundamentals and exposure to a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake / Redshift / BigQuery).
* \[Must\-Have] Basic Python scripting ability for data tasks.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP), internship or project\-level acceptable.
* Eager to learn, works well under guidance from senior engineers; not expected to design architecture independently.


**Nice\-to\-have Skills (either Level)**
* Experience with Databricks and Delta Lake.
* Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Databricks Workflows).
* dbt experience for transformation/modeling.
* Exposure to streaming technologies (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).
* Relevant certifications (Databricks Certified Data Engineer, Fivetran certification, cloud data engineer certs).
* Prior experience in \[specific industry, e.g., healthcare, finance, retail], if relevant.


**Responsibilities**
 Junior:
   

  

* Build and maintain PySpark transformations under senior engineer guidance.
* Set up and monitor assigned Fivetran connectors; escalate sync issues.
* Write and troubleshoot SQL queries for data validation.
* Document pipeline steps and support operational runbooks.


 SCREENING / SOURCING NOTES FOR RECRUITER
   

  

* For Senior: prioritize candidates who can clearly describe end\-to\-end pipeline ownership (source → Fivetran ingestion → PySpark transformation → warehouse load) and architecture decisions they made.
* For Junior: focus on fundamentals — can they explain what a Spark DataFrame is, how a Fivetran sync works, and walk through a project (academic or professional) where they used both?
* Ask for specific metrics from Senior candidates: data volumes handled, number of Fivetran connectors managed, pipeline runtime improvements.
* Confirm recency: look for PySpark/Fivetran usage within the last \[1–2] years, not just legacy ETL tools.
* Target keywords for boolean search: "PySpark" AND "Fivetran" AND ("Snowflake" OR "Redshift" OR "BigQuery") AND ("Databricks" OR "EMR" OR "Glue").
* Add experience\-range filters per level: Junior \= 1–3 yrs total; Senior \= 5\+ yrs total, with 3\+ yrs specifically in PySpark/Fivetran.

* Social intelligence
* Innovation and agility

title: Mobile QA
description:
**About the job** 




  





**Company Description** 





 Asymmetric Labs is an AI\-first, new\-age ed\-tech company focused on delivering measurable outcomes such as improved ranks, job placements, and sustained career progression, currently in stealth mode.
 



* Backed by Tier 1 US VCs
* Founding team of serial entrepreneurs
* Global team (Singapore / India / US)




 Team members work on cutting\-edge learning technologies that aim to redefine how learners achieve their goals.
 




  





**About the Role** 





 The AI\-Native Mobile QC Engineer owns product quality for our Android and iOS learning apps, working at the intersection of testing, tooling, and AI. You will use AI tools as core instruments of the job — generating test cases from PRDs and designs, triaging bugs, and catching regressions before they reach students. The role requires balancing speed with rigor across both platforms in a fast\-moving, content\-heavy mobile product.
 




  





**Ideal Candidate** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* 0–3 years of experience in QA/QC, ideally on mobile apps; experience testing both Android and iOS preferred.
* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, GPT, or similar) daily — for test case generation, log analysis, or bug triage — as a core part of the workflow, not an add\-on.
* Sharp eye for UI/UX inconsistency and attention to detail, including platform\-specific behavior differences (Android vs. iOS).
* Working knowledge of Linear/Jira or a similar issue tracker.
* Ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports with proper severity, platform, and repro steps.
* Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments with fast release cycles.
* Curiosity, ownership mindset, and willingness to work in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Bonus: exposure to Maestro (Android) and/or XCUITest (iOS), or Figma.



  





**Scope of Work** 



* Own end\-to\-end quality for both the Android and iOS apps — functional and UI/UX testing.
* Use AI tools to generate test matrices, edge cases, and exploratory testing plans directly from PRDs and Figma designs.
* File clear, reproducible bug reports into Linear/Jira with proper severity, platform (Android/iOS), and repro steps.
* Review new feature builds against acceptance criteria before release sign\-off, cross\-checking parity between Android and iOS.
* Partner closely with Android and iOS engineering to close the loop on fixes and verify regressions.
* Continuously improve QC process — checklists, release checklists.
* Flag UX friction and content rendering issues.
* Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate feedback collection with content and academic teams.

description:

 Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.
   

  

 Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud \- managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K\+ customers in 175\+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer II (SRE II) to help ensure the stability, scalability, and reliability of our services and infrastructure. This role focuses on building automation, maintaining observability, and supporting incident response to keep customer\-facing systems performing at their best. The SRE will collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed reliability practices into day\-to\-day development and operations while contributing to tools and processes that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Service Reliability \& Operations**
* Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments.
* Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and escalate issues when thresholds are at risk.
* Participate in on\-call rotations, incident response, and post\-incident reviews to drive service improvements.
* Follow established ITIL/OSS processes (incident, change, problem, and capacity management).


**Automation \& Tooling**
* Develop automation for common operational tasks, reducing manual intervention and toil.
* Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Catchpoint,ELK).
* Work with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins).
* Write scripts (Bash, Python, Go, etc.) to improve system reliability and efficiency.


**Collaboration**
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to support resilient system design and operations.
* Assist in capacity planning and disaster recovery exercises.
* Work with vendors and service providers to troubleshoot service issues and track SLA performance.
* Document systems, share learnings, and help grow a reliability\-minded engineering culture.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Contribute to playbooks, runbooks, and operational documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and propose long\-term improvements.
* Promote reliability\-focused practices within development and operations teams.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2–4 years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, or operations.
* Exposure to large\-scale, production\-grade systems.


**Technical Skills**
* Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Familiarity with service reliability concepts \- monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or Go).
* Understanding of containers (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices concepts.
* Knowledge of incident response and operational best practices.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Experience in a SaaS, service provider, or distributed systems environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL/OSS practices and SLO/SLA’s
* Strong problem\-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive projects from problem discovery through resolution.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Medcity International Academy (MIA) is a premier training and coaching institution headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, with multiple centers across Kerala and Karnataka. The Academy is a leading provider of English language proficiency and professional assessment test training, with a strong focus on international exam success and global employability. MIA offers specialized preparatory programs for major language tests and healthcare professional assessments, supported by experienced trainers certified by global bodies. The institution combines evidence\-based teaching, digital tools, personalized coaching, language labs, mock examinations, and an app\-based learning ecosystem to support online and classroom learners. Its mission is to expand global opportunities for students and professionals across healthcare, IT, engineering, hospitality, aviation, tourism, and communications through impactful education and strategic training.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Study Abroad Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kochi, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end counseling and support for learners pursuing international education opportunities. The role includes guiding students on suitable countries, universities, and programs, managing application and documentation processes, and coordinating with global partner institutions and agencies. The Study Abroad Manager will conduct consultations, information sessions, and workshops, while maintaining accurate records of student cases and timelines. The position also involves collaborating with internal training teams to align test preparation with study abroad requirements, monitoring visa procedures and compliance updates, and driving marketing and outreach activities to grow the study abroad portfolio. The manager will be expected to achieve enrollment targets, ensure high\-quality student experience, and provide clear, ethical guidance to learners and their families.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Experience in expediting and working as an expeditor, ensuring timely processing of student applications and documentation.

* Proficiency in project management, including planning, tracking, and delivering multiple student cases and intakes on schedule.
* Background in inspection or quality checks to verify completeness and accuracy of application materials and compliance documents.
* Prior experience in overseas education consulting, international admissions, or student counseling is highly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex processes clearly to diverse audiences.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a postgraduate qualification in education, management, or international relations is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with CRM or student management systems.
* Knowledge of major study destinations, visa procedures, and international education trends.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and meet performance targets in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Junior Telecom Core network Engineer / Programmer
description:
We're building the next generation of our platform, and alongside our senior specialists, we want to build the next generation of
 *engineers* 
 — people who are early in their telecom career, genuinely curious about how mobile networks work, and disciplined enough to grow into something serious.
 



 If you have 1\-2 years of experience, or even none at all, but you can show us real curiosity and real discipline — we want to hear from you.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**What matters more to us than your CVs** 




 We'd rather hire someone with one year of experience and the right attitude than someone with five years and none of the following:
 


* **You take ownership.** 
 When something is your responsibility, it stays your responsibility until it's actually done — not until it's someone else's problem.
* **You have discipline.** 
 You show up, you follow through, and you do the unglamorous parts of the job as carefully as the interesting parts.
* **You want to be told when you're wrong.** 
 Telecom networks are unforgiving of guesswork. We need people who would rather hear "that's not right, here's why" early than get it wrong in front of a live network later.
* **You're genuinely curious about telecoms.** 
 Not just software. Not just AI. The actual mechanics of how a phone call or a data session works across a mobile network.



  





 You'll work directly alongside our network engineer and NOC/support engineer, learning the real operational side of running a live mobile core network — not from a textbook, but on our actual platform:
 


* **Monitoring** 
 live network health and learning to read the signals before they become problems
* **Learning** 
 to form your own diagnosis of a network fault
 *before* 
 you're shown what our diagnostic tooling suggests — we deliberately train engineers to think for themselves first, not to just read an answer
* **Assisting** 
 with support tickets and learning the discipline of a structured incident response
* **Shadowing** 
 network function commissioning and configuration work
* T
 **aking part** 
 in regular structured learning exercises designed specifically to build real diagnostic judgement over time, not just task completion



  





  





**Qualifications** 




 A degree in telecommunications, electronics, computer science, or engineering . though we care more about what you understand than what's on the certificate

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Network Engineer** 




  





**Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to join our Managed Services team, focused on delivering high\-quality network solutions and ongoing support for our clients. This role requires a strong technical foundation in enterprise networking, combined with a service\-oriented mindset and a commitment to operational excellence.
 



 The ideal candidate will play a key role in executing network projects, maintaining and optimizing client environments, and contributing to the use of repeatable processes aligned with IT Service Management (ITSM) best practices. You will collaborate closely with internal teams, external stakeholders, and vendors to ensure seamless service delivery and client satisfaction.
 



 This position demands a proactive approach to problem\-solving, excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. A passion for structured operations and continuous improvement is essential.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Support customer\-focused network projects, including technical planning, execution, and project\-related discussions with customers.
* Perform day\-to\-day network security support, including upgrades, patching, and policy tuning, primarily in Fortinet environments, Aruba and Cisco environments.
* Configure and maintain firewalls, VPNs, and security appliances.
* Conduct network assessments and provide recommendations for improvements.
* Collaborate with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Document configurations, procedures, and build network diagrams.
* Provide Tier 2/3 support for escalated network and security issues.
* Participate in on\-call rotation and after\-hours maintenance as needed.
* Available for after\-hours escalations and change windows.
* Ability to multi\-task, pivot quickly, and understand “sense of urgency.”
* Support network\-related projects such as firewall refreshes, upgrades, and client onboarding activities.
* Assist with project implementation tasks, including configuration changes, testing, and post\-change validation.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 7–10 years of hands\-on experience with enterprise networking background.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer); Cisco and Aruba Networks.
* Strong experience with Aruba LAN and Aruba ClearPass technologies.
* Experience with SD\-WAN technologies, deployments and support
* Working knowledge of scripting or automation (Python, Shell scripting, and Java) is required
* Strong understanding of network security, segmentation, Zero Trust principles, firewall policies, and Access Control Lists (ACLs).
* Strong experience in network device patching, firmware upgrades, and vulnerability remediation.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, NAT, VPN).
* Experience with firewall rule management, UTM features, and IPS/IDS.
* Familiarity with centralized management platforms and logging tools.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex network and security issues.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Experience working in an MSP or multi\-tenant environment is a strong plus



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Fortinet NSE 4/5/6/7 certifications are highly desirable; equivalent networking or security certifications (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto, or cloud networking) are an asset.
* Experience with other security platforms (e.g., Cisco ASA, Palo Alto, WatchGuard, Pfsense, Meraki) is an asset.
* Exposure to cloud networking and security concepts across Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of business and technology processes within enterprise IT environments.
* Proven experience managing and resolving technical escalations in customer\-facing or enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL) and enterprise operational best practices.
* Proven experience contributing to process improvement and operational maturity.
* Excellent critical thinking and emotional intelligence skills.
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure monitoring systems (e.g., LogicMonitor, SolarWinds).
* University degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.



  





**Certifications** 



* Aruba ClearPass certification and Firewall certifications are highly desirable.
* CCNA and above certification required.

* Good written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills required

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking an AI Engineer to build and implement AI systems for content production at scale. You'll work at the intersection of engineering and content designing prompt pipelines, integrating generative models, and building the tooling that turns source material into finished creative output. The ideal candidate is technically strong but also has taste: someone who understands story and craft, and can tell the difference between output that's technically correct and output that's actually good.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and iterate on prompt pipelines and multi\-agent workflow components
* Design and integrate agentic workflows orchestrate multi\-step, tool\-using agents that plan, call models, and hand off between stages in production
* Deploy and serve open\-source models set up inference endpoints, manage GPU compute, and optimize for latency and cost
* Write evals compare outputs against references, quantify quality, and feed results back into the pipeline
* Work on data pipelines: structured extraction from messy source text, localization, similarity/dedup
* Debug and maintain pipeline stages in production


**What You Bring**
* (1\+/3\+) years of engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects
* Solid Python fundamentals clean, working, readable code
* Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and prompt engineering (personal projects count)
* Comfort with Git, REST APIs, and working in a Linux environment
* A feel for content and narrative you can judge whether generated output is actually good, not just valid
* Curiosity and clear communication you ask good questions and don't stay stuck silently


**Preferred**

* Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or RAG (Qdrant, pgvector)

* Experience writing evals or LLM\-as\-judge scoring

title: Jr. AI Backend Engineer
description:
**Junior AI  Backend Engineer** 




**Mode:** 
 Remote / Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-3 Years
 



**ABOUT US** 




 We are an engineering team building AI agent systems that automate complex knowledge work — document generation, structured reasoning, and multi\-step task orchestration. Our systems are deployed in production and used by real teams to make real decisions.We build carefully, govern rigorously, and take quality seriously.
 



**THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE** 




 As a Junior AI / Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for building the backend services and agent pipelines that make LLM outputs reliable, structured, and safe to use in production. Your work will sit at the foundation of every agent capability we ship.
 



 This is systems engineering around AI models
 



**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* **API Development:** 
 Design and maintain FastAPI services that expose agent capabilities as clean, versioned APIs.
* **Agent Pipelines:** 
 Build LangChain orchestration pipelines with structured I/O contracts, retry logic, and fallback handling.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** 
 Work with Azure infrastructure including Azure OpenAI Service, Blob Storage, and Container Apps.
* **Output Reliability:** 
 Implement output validation and schema enforcement layers that make LLM responses trustworthy enough for production use.
* **Codebase Contribution:** 
 Write code that your teammates can read, review, and build on without friction.
  

  



**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** 




**Required** 




 – 1\-3 years of Python development with at least one production deployment behind you.
 



 – Solid grasp of async Python and REST API design, with the debugging instincts to match.
 



 – Hands\-on experience with LangChain or a comparable LLM orchestration library.
 



 – Working knowledge of Azure: OpenAI Service, Blob Storage, and App Service or Container Apps.
 



 – You understand why output validation, structured schemas, and retry logic matter in production — not just that they exist.
 



 – Comfortable working in a shared codebase with other engineers.
 



**Preferred** 




 – Pydantic for structured output parsing and schema validation.
 



 – Experience with RAG pipelines or document ingestion workflows.
 



 – Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
 



 – Any prior work building multi\-step or tool\-using LLM agents.
 



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 We are not looking for someone who knows everything. We are looking for someone who ships, learns, and communicates clearly. A strong candidate will be able to show:
 



 – You have built a REST API that other services depend on.
 



 – You have integrated an external API and handled its failure modes, not just the happy path.
 



 – You can explain a design decision, defend it under pushback, and revise it when shown a better argument.
 



**OUT OF SCOPE FOR THIS ROLE** 




 In the interest of honesty, the following are not part of this position:
 



 – Prompt engineering as the primary responsibility.
 



 – Frontend or UI development.
 



 – Machine learning model training or fine\-tuning.
 



 – Autonomous deployment to production environments without engineer review.
 



**TECHNOLOGY STACK** 




 Python  \|  FastAPI  \|  LangChain  \|  Azure OpenAI  \|  Azure Blob Storage  \|  Container Apps  \|  Pydantic  \|  GitHub / Azure DevOps
 



**WHY WORK WITH US** 




 – You will work on systems that are used in real projects by real teams — not internal demos or sandboxed experiments.
 



 – You will work closely with senior engineers and architects, not be left to figure things out alone.
 



 – Code quality, system design, and governance are taken seriously here. Your standards will be matched.
 



 – Remote\-friendly and outcome\-focused. We care about what you ship, not when you log in.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose** 




 To develop, program, integrate, and optimize robotic welding systems for fabrication operations, ensuring high productivity, superior weld quality, equipment reliability, and continuous process improvement while supporting manufacturing excellence and operational efficiency.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




**1\. Robot Programming \& System Integration** 



* Develop, modify, and implement online and offline robot programs for KUKA robotic welding systems.
* Integrate robotic arms with PLCs, sensors, vision systems, and peripheral equipment.
* Commission robotic welding cells and support new automation projects.



**2\. Welding Process Optimization** 



* Define and optimize welding parameters including voltage, current, travel speed, wire feed, and shielding gas.
* Improve welding efficiency, reduce cycle time, and maximize equipment utilization.
* Continuously monitor and optimize robotic welding performance.



**3\. Quality Assurance** 



* Ensure robotic welds comply with applicable quality standards and codes such as ASME, AWS, and ISO.
* Perform root cause analysis for welding defects and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Support quality improvement initiatives to enhance weld consistency and structural integrity.



**4\. Equipment Maintenance \& Troubleshooting** 



* Diagnose and resolve robotic hardware, software, electrical, and mechanical issues.
* Develop preventive maintenance practices and equipment repair standards.
* Establish spare parts inventory and maintenance procedures to minimize downtime.



**5\. Tooling \& Fixture Development** 



* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Design, and Tooling teams to develop welding fixtures and improve part fit\-up.
* Support implementation of new tooling and automation solutions for improved productivity.



**6\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Lead and execute projects focused on cost reduction, productivity improvement, safety, ergonomics, standardization, and quality enhancement.
* Support Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives across fabrication operations.
* Facilitate production teams in implementing process improvement activities.



**7\. Problem Solving \& QRCI** 



* Support the QRCI (Quick Response Continuous Improvement) process.
* Lead root cause investigations and implement immediate containment as well as permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure effective documentation and follow\-up of improvement actions.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or equivalent.



**Experience** 



* 5–10 years of hands\-on experience in industrial robotic welding applications within fabrication, heavy engineering, automotive, process equipment, or similar manufacturing industries.



**Required Technical Skills** 



* Hands\-on experience in programming KUKA robotic welding systems.
* Strong knowledge of robotic welding processes including GMAW (MIG) and GTAW (TIG).
* Sound understanding of welding metallurgy and welding parameters.
* Knowledge of PLC integration, industrial sensors, and vision systems.
* Experience with offline programming and robot simulation software such as RoboDK or Process Simulate.
* Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD.
* Knowledge of welding quality standards including ASME, AWS, and ISO.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.

title: EMBEDDED SYSTEMS ENGINEER
description:
We are looking for a passionate and motivated Embedded Systems Engineer to join our embedded development team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technologies including Lidar/Radar sensor integration, advanced sensor fusion algorithms, and real\-time graphics\-oriented embedded applications. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in Embedded Systems development using modern platforms (Arduino, ESP32, STM32N6\) and strong programming skills in Rust for embedded applications, combined with expertise in sensor data processing and real\-time device development.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop embedded applications using Embedded C/C\+\+, Rust, MicroPython for real\-time systems.
* Design and implement sensor fusion algorithms using LiDAR, Radar, IMU, accelerometers, and differential pressure sensors.
* Work on Arduino\-based embedded development and prototyping platforms, as well as advanced platforms like STM32N6, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi.
* Develop graphics\-oriented embedded applications using WGPU and related rendering frameworks for real\-time display systems.
* Design, develop, test, and debug firmware for embedded devices and advanced hardware platforms with real\-time constraints.
* Interface and integrate advanced peripherals including Lidar/Radar sensors, displays, communication modules, and multi\-axis sensors.
* Implement and optimize communication protocols including UART, SPI, I2C, RS232, RS485, CAN, CAN\-FD, and LoRaWAN P2P.
* Develop real\-time signal processing and data filtering algorithms for continuous sensor data streams.
* Read and understand complex schematics, sensor datasheets, and technical documentation for advanced electronic systems.
* Assist in hardware\-software integration, embedded device validation, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot complex hardware and firmware\-related issues in real\-time systems.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for development activities and design decisions.
* Collaborate with internal teams during product development, testing phases, and sensor integration projects.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Proven hands\-on experience in embedded systems development using modern platforms (Arduino, ESP32, STM32N6 or similar).
* Strong programming skills in Rust for embedded applications or equivalent systems programming language.
* Solid experience with Embedded C/C\+\+ development and firmware programming.
* Hands\-on experience with microcontroller platforms (STM32N6, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar).
* Experience with embedded communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, RS232/RS485, CAN/CAN\-FD).
* Proficiency with embedded debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, SWD).
* Good understanding of electronics, PCB integration, and circuit interfacing principles.
* Excellent debugging and problem\-solving skills for complex embedded systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, datasheets, and complex schematics.
* Experience: 1\+ Year



  





**Desirable Skills \& Experience:** 



* Experience with Lidar or Radar sensor integration and signal processing.
* Knowledge of sensor fusion algorithms and multi\-sensor data integration (IMU, accelerometers, pressure sensors).
* Real\-time signal processing and digital signal processing (DSP) experience.
* Experience with RTOS (Real\-Time Operating Systems) concepts and implementation.
* Familiarity with graphics rendering frameworks and GPU programming (WGPU, OpenGL, etc).
* Knowledge of advanced communication protocols (LoRaWAN, Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi integration).
* Understanding of power management, battery systems, and low\-power embedded design.
* Experience with version control systems and collaborative development practices.
* Familiarity with safety\-critical or aerospace\-grade embedded systems development is a plus.
