description:
**About Anthrobyte**




 Anthrobyte is an enterprise AI company helping organisations move from experimentation to production\-grade AI adoption. We believe successful AI transformation begins with understanding people, systems, and decision\-making before technology. Our work spans enterprise products, AI workflows, digital platforms, and organisational transformation — designing solutions that make complex systems understandable, trustworthy, and valuable.
   





 As our products and client engagements continue to grow, we are looking for a UI/UX Designer who enjoys turning complexity into clarity and is excited to build products that solve real enterprise problems.
   





**What You'll Do**




 This is not a role where you will simply execute screens from handed\-over wireframes.
   





 You will work directly with the Head of Design to shape Anthrobyte's digital experiences, from our company website to enterprise AI platforms used by global organisations. You'll help translate our brand into intuitive product experiences while learning how enterprise products are designed, validated, and shipped.
   





 Many of our products deal with complex workflows, operational intelligence, large datasets, dashboards, AI insights, and information\-heavy experiences. Your role will be to transform this complexity into interfaces that are clear, accessible, and enjoyable to use.
   





 If you're curious, enjoy solving difficult design problems, and want to grow beyond visual design into product thinking, this role will provide that opportunity.
   





**What You'll Make**




**—** 
**Product Design —** 
 Design user interfaces for enterprise web applications and AI\-powered products. Create wireframes, user flows, high\-fidelity mock\-ups, prototypes, and production\-ready designs. Design intuitive workflows for complex enterprise use cases involving large amounts of information. Translate business requirements into user\-centred digital experiences. Work closely with developers throughout implementation to ensure design quality.
   





**—** 
**Website \& Digital Experience —** 
 Design and continuously improve the Anthrobyte website. Translate our evolving brand language into engaging digital experiences. Balance visual aesthetics with usability, accessibility, and business objectives. Conduct research to understand the expectations and behaviours of enterprise decision\-makers and B2B users.
   





**—** 
**User Experience —** 
 Apply UX principles throughout the design process. Conduct competitor analysis, usability evaluations, and user research where appropriate. Design information architecture that helps users understand complex systems with minimal effort. Apply established usability principles including Nielsen's Heuristics, UX Laws, accessibility guidelines, and interaction design best practices.
   





**—** 
**Design Systems —** 
 Contribute to Anthrobyte's design system and component library. Maintain consistency across products, websites, and future digital experiences. Document components and design patterns for developers and future designers.
   





**—** 
**AI\-Enabled Design —** 
 Use modern AI tools to improve research, ideation, prototyping, documentation, and design workflows. Explore new ways AI can improve productivity while maintaining high design quality and human\-centred thinking.
   

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


**What We're Looking For**




 We're less interested in knowing every tool and more interested in how you think.
   





 You enjoy solving problems, ask thoughtful questions, and care about creating experiences that make people's work easier.
   





 You bring:
   




**—** 
 Up to 2 years of experience in UI, UX, Product Design, or related fields.
   

**—** 
 A portfolio demonstrating your design thinking and problem\-solving process.
   

**—** 
 Strong proficiency in Figma.
   

**—**

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Meet The Team**
 Develops software consistent with Cisco ‘Build Thinking Principles’ with a focus on simplification and UX (User Experience) at its core, using secure coding practices, ensuring user privacy, and following software development best practices. Partners with other teams including build and product management to build the right solution for the customers. Builds technical design documentation to be used by the team as well as contributing to user documentation to be used by end users. Debugs and addresses software issues during development and in production systems to support customers. Brings new ideas for product innovation and helps improve software development processes.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Advanced experienced professional using best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services.
* Works independently but receives minimal guidance and direction from leader then determines best approach to accomplish work.
* Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience.
* Understands project and/or department needs and establishes relationships with appropriate cross\-functional stakeholders to gather input, collect information and complete work steps.
* May lead projects from end\-to\-end through delegation, review, and driving results holistically.
* May lead medium features from technical build through completion.
* May contribute to a defined software engineering roadmap.
* Identifies and recommends improvements to the software development lifecycle and best practices in agile engineering.
* Leads delivery of high\-quality build of features and deliverables.
* Identifies opportunities for multiple products to work together to create value for customers.
* Integrates product sense as it relates to build of the product (market awareness, production adoption, competition) and supervises related metrics.
* Writes functional clean code and unit tests with no mentorship.
* Maintains and enhances solutions by fixing complicated errors, raising risks, and escalating issues where necessary.
* Identifies immediate and larger scope problems through thorough code reviews.
* Tests and reviews code to optimize scale, velocity, and reliability of deliverables.
* Contributes to threat modeling of a feature.
* Monitors the production environment and works cross\-functionally to identify problems and track production systems.
* May serve as escalation point for on\-call issues.
* Leads postmortem and writes root cause analysis.
* Expert on multiple functional components.
* Shares knowledge across teams, both informally and formally (e.g., ad\-hoc basis, internal presentations, blogs, newsletters).
* Coordinates across teams to estimate times and complete projects according to specification and user requirements.
* Tracks milestones, progress and provides ongoing updates and remediation plans to cross\-functional partners.
* Mentors peers or more junior team members.
* Assists other engineers through code reviews, documentation, and technical guidance.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelors \+ 7 years of related experience OR Masters \+ 4 years of related experience OR PhD \+ 1 year of related experience.
* Requires solid conceptual and practical knowledge in primary technical job family and knowledge of related technical job families; has worked with a range of technologies.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Varies based on the team and business needs \| Preferred Qualifications are desired education, experience, and skills that are in addition to Minimum Qualifications.

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Frontend React developer
description:
**The Team** 




  





 Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact\-driven decision\-making and generate an insight\-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence \& visualization, data management, performance management and next\-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.
 




  





**Your work profile** 




 We are looking for a React.js Developer with a strong foundation in software engineering principles, not just React development. The ideal candidate should be capable of building scalable, maintainable, and modular frontend applications. ReactJS\- Strong understanding of React fundamentals
 








  





**Key Required Skills** 




 3 \- 8 Years Experience.
 



  





**React.js** 



* Strong understanding of React fundamentals
* Functional components and Hooks
* State management (Context API, Redux, or similar)
* Component lifecycle and rendering behavior
* Performance optimization (memorization, lazy loading, code splitting)
* Routing using React Router
* API integration and asynchronous data handling
* From handling and validation
* Error boundaries and react best practices
* Reusable component development
* Strong knowledge of CSS
* Responsive design



**JavaScript \& TypeScript** 



* Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Closures, promises, async/await, event loop
* Modules and imports/exports
* TypeScript fundamentals (preferred)



**Software Engineering Fundamentals** 



* The candidate should have practical knowledge of:



**SOLID Principles** 



* Single Responsibility Principle
* Open/Closed Principle
* Liskov Substitution Principle
* Interface Segregation Principle
* Dependency Inversion Principle



**Clean Architecture** 



* Separation of concerns
* Layered architecture
* Business logic independent of UI
* Maintainable and testable code structure
* Clear understanding of presentation, domain, and data layers



**Design Patterns** 



* Factory Pattern
* Singleton Pattern
* Strategy Pattern
* Adapter Pattern
* Observer Pattern
* Dependency Injection concepts
* Ability to identify when and where design patterns should be applied



**Modular Architecture** 



* Feature\-based folder structure
* Modular and reusable code organization
* Shared utilities and common components
* Low coupling and high cohesion
* Scalable project architecture








  





**Education Qualification:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

title: Frontend Developer
description:
**This role is for one of the Weekday's clients**
 Min Experience: 3\+ years
   

  

 Location: Remote (India)
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for a talented and creative
 **Frontend Developer** 
 with 3\-7 years of experience in building highly interactive, visually engaging, and performance\-driven web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
 **Three.js** 
 and a passion for creating immersive 3D web experiences. You will work closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to develop modern user interfaces that combine functionality with exceptional visual appeal.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge web technologies, optimize rendering performance, and build scalable frontend applications that deliver seamless user experiences across devices.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain interactive 3D web applications using Three.js
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces with a strong focus on usability and performance
* Translate UI/UX designs into high\-quality, reusable frontend components
* Optimize rendering performance, animations, and graphics for smooth user interactions
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver innovative frontend solutions
* Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and responsiveness across desktop and mobile platforms
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve frontend issues while maintaining high code quality
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend architecture decisions
* Stay updated with emerging frontend technologies, 3D graphics techniques, and industry best practices


**Required Skills**
**Must\-Have**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Three.js for developing interactive 3D web experiences
* Solid understanding of 3D rendering concepts, animations, lighting, cameras, and scene management
* Experience optimizing WebGL applications for performance and scalability
* Good understanding of frontend architecture, reusable components, and modern development workflows
* Strong problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience with Next.js for building modern web applications
* Strong proficiency in React.js component\-based development
* Excellent knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+) and modern frontend development practices
* Familiarity with responsive web design and frontend performance optimization
* Understanding of API integration and asynchronous programming
* Knowledge of version control systems such as Git
* Exposure to deployment pipelines and modern build tools is an advantage


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 3\-7 years of professional experience in frontend web development
* Proven experience delivering high\-quality interactive web applications
* Portfolio or examples showcasing Three.js or 3D web projects will be highly preferred


**What We're Looking For**
 The ideal candidate is passionate about creating immersive digital experiences and enjoys solving complex frontend challenges. You should possess strong communication and collaboration skills, work effectively in an agile environment, and demonstrate ownership of your work from concept to deployment. A continuous learning mindset, creativity, and the ability to balance aesthetics with performance are key qualities for success in this role.

**Company Description**

The company focuses on innovation, quality, and tailored software solutions that help businesses turn ideas into scalable, high\-performance applications. With expertise in technologies such as Angular, React, Node.js, and SQL, Softkode’s teams build web applications that emphasize usability, performance, and best practices. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune City.

* Candidates should possess strong Front\-End Development skills, including experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, CSS, and Responsive Web Design.
* Candidates should possess solid Web Development and Software Development skills, with familiarity in version control, testing, and secure coding practices.

* Relevant experience in building scalable, high\-performance web applications and working within agile or iterative development environments.

* Strong problem\-solving abilities, attention to detail, and effective communication skills in collaborative, cross\-functional teams.

------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. **What you will need**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.

* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.

description:
The Benefits Specialist will serve as a key member of the People Operations Shared Services CoE, providing Tier 2 benefits administration support \-. The incumbent will work closely with the People Operations team, Total Rewards, external benefits vendors, and the Tier 1 support provider to ensure seamless, accurate, and compliant administration of employee benefits.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  

**1\. Workday Benefits Administration (Tier 2 Support)**


* Administer employee benefits within **Workday HCM**, including processing of:
	+ **Life Events** (e.g., marriage, new dependents, divorce)
	+ **Open Enrolment** cycles
	+ **Data corrections** and retroactive adjustments
	+ **Lifestyle Reimbursement** Requests
* Make employee\-level data adjustments within Workday across HCM, Compensation, and Benefits modules in response to government regulation changes or benefit plan modifications
* Execute **mass uploads** for onboarding of interns and apprentices (benefit data only)
* Maintain data integrity and accuracy across all benefits\-related records in Workday
  

  

**2\. Passive Events Administration**


* Monitor and administer **dependent eligibility events**
* Review and verify proof of full\-time education documentation submitted by employees
* Confirm continued eligibility with benefits vendors and amend coverage records in Workday accordingly
  

  

**3\. Lifestyle Reimbursement Processing**


* Process lifecycle reimbursement requests triggered via the **Workday inbox notification workflow**
* Review and approve employee\-submitted receipts in Workday
* Input approved one\-time payments directly into Workday in line with policy and internal controls
* Ensure all reimbursement controls are executed accurately and in compliance with GE Vernova policy
  

  

**4\. Vendor \& Carrier Liaison**


* Act as the Tier 2 point of contact for **benefits carriers and vendors**
* Transmit benefit and payroll data (reports/files) between Workday and vendors/payroll providers where automated Workday integrations are not yet in place
* Upload or share files securely with vendors via **Box** as part of manual interim processes
* Escalate and resolve vendor queries in collaboration with the PO team and Alight Strada
  

  

**5\. Tier 1 Triage \& Escalation Support**


* Support Tier 1 call center by resolving escalated employee and vendor inquiries that require Tier 2 benefits administration intervention
* Provide timely, accurate responses and guidance to ensure first\-contact resolution where possible
* Log, track, and close service cases efficiently within the case management system
  

  

**6\. Compliance \& Regulatory Support**


* Implement all administrative activities to adhere to legislative requirements and GE Vernova internal policy standards
  

  

**7\. Transition Support**


* Support the **manual processing** of vendor files
* Contribute to process documentation, knowledge transfer, and stabilization activities as the team transitions from the incumbent resource to the CoE model
* Support readiness activities including the setup of automated Workday integrations with benefit vendors
  

**Required Qualifications:**


* This role requires 3\+ years of experience in Human Resources \& HR Operations Service Delivery. Knowledge level is comparable to a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
* Customer\-centric mindset with a commitment to employee experience
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work across geographies and time zones
* Process\-oriented with an ability to document and improve workflows with a LEAN mindset
* Should be flexible to work to support countries in different time zones
  

  

**Desired Characteristics:**


* Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
* Strong working knowledge of Workday, Service Cloud, Powerpoint, MS Excel.
* Experience in LEAN processes
* Benefits knowledge: Familiarity with employee benefits schemes, compliance requirements, and regulatory frameworks

==========================

description:
About Us

We run three businesses in the Chandigarh/Baddi region: an LPG distribution agency, a 24\-hour HPCL fuel station, and a Takeaway delivery Restaurant. Around 45–50 staff work across the three — drivers, sales staff, kitchen team, and office staff. We run on written SOPs and Notion, and we need one person to own everything people\-related.

What You Will Own

**1\. Attendance \& Leave (daily)**

* Maintain attendance and leave records for all staff across the three businesses
* Hand over the verified attendance sheet to our accountant by the 1st of every month for salary processing
* Flag repeated absences or unusual patterns to the owner

**2\. Induction (whenever someone joins)**

* Run the joining process: documents, ID proofs, bank details, appointment letter
* Conduct day\-one induction using our ready checklists and SOPs
* Ensure every new person has their role workbook and knows exactly what they do from day one

**3\. Training Records (monthly)**

* Keep a training register: who was trained on what, when, and by whom
* Schedule refresher training whenever an SOP is updated
* Maintain mandatory records: food handler medical certificates (kitchen staff), safety training records (LPG drivers)

**4\. Intern \& Hiring Coordination (as needed)**

* Coordinate with college placement cells: schedule interviews, follow up, onboard interns
* Post job openings, do first screening calls, arrange interviews with the owner
* Handle exits: notice period, handover checklist, final settlement coordination with accounts

What You Will NOT Do

No operational decisions. Deliveries, fuel, and kitchen matters are handled by operations staff. You manage people records — not business operations.

Who We Are Looking For

* 2–4 years of HR experience, ideally with field or blue\-collar staff (drivers, retail, kitchen)
* Comfortable with Google Sheets; willing to learn Notion (we will train you)
* Fluent Hindi/Punjabi, working English for documentation
* Own two\-wheeler preferred (weekly site visit)
* Organized, follows checklists, does not need reminders

Why This Role Is Good

Everything is already documented — SOPs, checklists, and templates exist. You are not building from scratch; you are running a system. You get direct access to the owner, with no layers in between.

How to Apply

Send your CV with the subject line “HR Executive – Part Time”. Shortlisted candidates will get a short phone screening followed by one in\-person interview.

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. title: Head of Human Resources - Global Innovation Center
description:
Title: **Head of Human Resources – Global Innovation Center**

We are looking for a Head of HR for our newly established Global Innovation Center (GIC) in Pune, India. You will be responsible for building, scaling, and running the full people strategy for the Jefferies GIC. In this role, you will play an important part in developing the talent, helping create the culture, and be deeply involved in governance, and the people operations framework needed to operate a high performing, innovation\-driven global center.  



**Key Responsibilities**

*HR Strategy \& Organizational Build\-Out*

* Establish the HR operating model for the GIC, aligned with Jefferies’ global people strategy, and localized for the Pune labor market.
* Partner with the GIC leadership team to align HR priorities with delivery demands.
* Build and lead the end\-to\-end people lifecycle for the GIC including workforce planning, onboarding, performance management, compensation including benchmarking to local market, and management of employee relations in partnership with employment legal.
Establish and continuously refine organization structures, role architecture, and capability frameworks that support scaled growth.  
* 

*Stakeholder Management \& Leadership*

* Serve as the primary HR business advisor to the GIC Head and global technology leaders.
* Partner closely with global HR leadership including Global Head of HR, Asia Head of HR, Corporate Head of HR and Global Head of Recruiting to ensure the GIC develops as a seamless extension of Jefferies’ global organizational model.
* Represent the GIC HR function in global forums, governance committees, and transformation programs.
* Provide development, training, guidance, and leadership to new GIC HR team members.
Help identify and successfully hire the GIC HR team.  
* 

*Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning*

* Partner with recruiting leadership and global stakeholders to support the development and execution of a comprehensive hiring strategy. This will include contributing to superday hiring initiatives, advancing workforce diversity goals, and helping to define the technical requirements that enable the recruiting team to build a strong candidate pipeline aligned to the GIC’s strategic objectives.
* Ensure all hiring processes are consistent with Jefferies’ global standards and local regulatory requirements.
In partnership with Head of Recruiting for GIC, drive leadership hiring and oversee recruitment governance, vendor management, and capacity planning.  
* 

*Culture, Engagement \& Local HR Policy*

* In partnership with Technology leaders, define the Jefferies culture of the GIC.
* Advise and partner closely with the India HR team across the two established Jefferies entities, and employment legal in establishing regulatory requirements such as India Labor codes and ensuring ongoing compliance.
* Localize global people policies, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment to GIC local culture.
Design and deliver employee engagement strategies, leadership development, inclusion initiatives, and communication programs to foster a cohesive, high performance GIC culture.  
* 

*Compensation, Performance \& Development*

* Establish performance management frameworks optimized for GIC talent.
* Lead compensation and benefits strategy for the GIC in partnership with Compensation \& Benefits team, driving alignment with the GIC market.
Partner with the global Training \& Development and Community \& Engagement teams to design capability building programs.  
* 

*HR Governance \& Compliance*

* Ensure the GIC is audit ready across all HR processes, partnering with Global HR, Compliance, and Legal.
* Operationalize local employment requirements relevant to Pune.
Lead engagement with external audits for items related to Pune and the GIC.  
* 

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* 15\+ years of experience in financial services business advisory HR leadership, with experience leading HR for GICs, shared services, or global operations businesses.
* Proven experience in growth environments and building HR functions from the ground up.
* Extensive knowledge of the Pune talent market with strong local labor law and regulatory experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and matrix organization influencing skills; experience partnering with global functional heads.
* Proven track record in leadership and management of employment relations matters.
* Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast scaling, environment.
* Experience managing HR transformation and change\-management initiatives.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Learning Operations, Performance Management processes, Stakeholder Management, Workday/LMS platforms, Data Analytics \& Reporting, Process Improvement, as well as other job\-specific skillsets.


This role will be based out of Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To deliver HR services and support to Barclays colleagues, candidates, alumni and third\-party vendors.


**Accountabilities**


* Delivery and execution of HR operational activities aligned with people leader and colleague journeys aligned with bank policies and regulations, including performance management, rewards, benefits and learning operations documentation, coordination, and administration.
* On\- and offboarding of new employees, (including orientation, documentation, coordination, exit interviews), knowledge transfer performance, rewards, learning operations and related administration.
* Maintenance of colleague personal and reference data in relevant HR information systems, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with data privacy regulations, reporting and analytics.
* Provision of guidance and support on candidate, colleague and alumni queries relating to HR policies, procedures, processes, or guidance.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Medical Writer- Publications
description:
Job description:

Cactus Life Sciences partners with global biopharma to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes through agile, science\-driven medical communications — transforming complex data into actionable insights.  

As a growing scientific communications agency, we are looking for a driven leader to manage and support our project management workstream. In this role, you will lead a small team, manage diverse stakeholders, maintain full visibility of on\-going projects, and ensure all outputs are delivered to the highest quality.  

Please note: We are a remote\-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
Job responsibilities:
* Use scientific expertise to develop (write, proofread, and data\-check) high\-quality, client\-ready scientific, medical, and educational materials like slides, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, MSL/training slide decks, infographics, congress and meetings materials, literature searches and reviews, standard response letters/medical information letters, and HCP engagement content according to client needs with excellent attention to detail under the guidance of the scientific leads.
* Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas \- learning to anticipate their needs.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
* Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
* Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
* Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS’ internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
* Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting\-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
* Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.


\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* 2\-4 years of experience in publications within a pharma company or medical communications agency.
* PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
* Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to adapt writing style to suit different materials and target audiences.
* Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
* Very good working knowledge of MS Office and basic knowledge of biostatistics.
* Shows an eagerness to learn and apply AI tools and technologies.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process includes two Technical Interviews with the Hiring Manager and peers, and a Technical Assessment, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the HR Interview. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

 **AI at Cactus Life Sciences**  

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.  

AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.  

We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.  

You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

 **Equal Opportunity**


Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.


About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.


Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future\-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

* Provide comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to the Deputy General Manager.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

description:
**Job (Assignment) Title: Payroll Lead Coordinator**

**Function/Department: HR/Payroll**

**Reports To: Manager, Payroll**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Process payroll information to generate accurate and timely payments for multiple US \& EMEA based entities. Duties include balancing and controlling earnings and deduction totals, inspecting automated system output such as registers and standard reports, determining and correcting out\-of\-balance conditions.  

* 

* **RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Accurately review and process time in the Time and Attendance system. Verification of data and manager sign off is critical.
* Process bi\-weekly payroll including regular, overtime and special payments.
* Review payroll information for accuracy and propriety. Includes detailed understanding of payroll system reports.
* Research and resolve employee questions about significant payroll issues.
* SOX compliance is Assist in the communication of payroll policies to employees.
* Assist in the communication of payroll policies to employees.
* Help manage the filing of payroll information for year end.
* Work with General Accounting and Human Resource teams to ensure close alignment with Financial Statements and accurate processing of individual pay.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives for payroll processes, identifying opportunities for automation, increased efficiency, and enhanced accuracy.
* Act as a subject matter expert and point of contact for complex payroll issues, supporting internal stakeholders and mentoring junior payroll team members as needed.
* Overtime required, as needed, to meet payroll deadlines.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Minimum Job Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of **US \& EMEA** payroll principles, laws and regulations.
* Proficiency with **ADP** payroll software and **Oracle Time and Labor** timekeeping system.
* **CertifiedUS** **Payroll Professional** \- CPP or FPC.
* **Bachelor’s degree** in Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources or any relevant area.
* Excellent numerical and analytical skills.
* Problem solving abilities and strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and professionalism.
* Competent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines.
5\+ years of experience in payroll administration.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven experience with certified and Union payroll, processing Stock options and SOX compliance controls.
* Experience implementing new payroll systems or migrating payroll processes to share service center.

 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.

description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


An individual in 1LoD Compliance Risk Management plays a critical role in managing the bank's diverse risks to ensure financial stability and sustained growth. This integral role within the bank ensures operations are within a defined risk appetite and contribute to the overall objectives of the bank. The individual is responsible for the In\-business Risk Management regulatory change reviews impacting the Human Resources (HR) organization. **Recommended Qualifications**:


* Experience: 6\-10 years in Risk Management, Audit, Compliance, or a related control function.
* Governance \& Culture: Proven ability to lead strong governance, foster a culture of responsible finance, and uphold ethical standards.
* Audit \& Regulatory Management: Experience managing audit, compliance, and regulatory findings, including remediation efforts and serving as a primary liaison for audit groups.
* Risk Assessment \& Mitigation: Deep understanding of risk identification, assessment, and mitigation strategies, with the ability to evaluate risk in key business decisions.
* Process Improvement \& Automation: Demonstrated capability in enhancing, automating, and simplifying control processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
* Project Leadership: Ability to design and lead complex projects that enhance processes and address intricate business challenges.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Advanced analytical skills to oversee performance through metrics, track corrective actions, and prepare risk presentations for senior management.

title: AI Talent Acquisition Manager (AI-First Hiring)
description:
**About Drytis**

Drytis is building the next generation of AI\-powered businesses.

Our philosophy is simple: every repetitive business process should eventually be automated through AI, allowing people to focus on strategy, decision\-making, and building meaningful relationships.

**Hiring is no exception.**

We are looking for young, energetic, and someone who believes recruitment should be driven by intelligent systems, structured evaluation, and data rather than manual effort alone.

If you're excited about combining recruitment expertise with AI, automation, and process optimization, we'd love to hear from you.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an AI Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and transform our end\-to\-end recruitment function.

This is not a traditional recruiter position.

You will be responsible for designing and managing an AI\-powered hiring ecosystem that enables faster hiring, better candidate evaluation, and an exceptional candidate experience.

Beyond filling positions, your responsibility will be to continuously improve hiring efficiency by building AI agents, automation workflows, and scalable recruitment processes that reduce manual effort while maintaining high hiring standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI\-Driven Recruitment**

* Design, build, and optimize AI agents that support sourcing, screening, candidate communication, interview scheduling, and recruitment operations.
* Develop intelligent workflows that automate repetitive recruitment tasks while maintaining a personalized candidate experience.
* Continuously improve AI prompts, workflows, evaluation frameworks, and hiring processes.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve speed, consistency, and hiring quality.

**Talent Acquisition**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from job posting through offer acceptance.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business requirements and define hiring strategies.
* Source high\-quality candidates across multiple platforms and channels.
* Conduct structured screening interviews and candidate evaluations.
* Coordinate interview processes and ensure a seamless candidate experience.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

**Recruitment Operations**

* Develop standardized hiring processes, scorecards, interview frameworks, and evaluation criteria.
* Maintain accurate recruitment data and reporting.
* Build scalable hiring documentation and knowledge repositories.
* Improve recruitment workflows using automation platforms and AI tools.

**Employer Branding**

* Collaborate with marketing and leadership to strengthen Drytis' employer brand.
* Create compelling job descriptions and recruitment campaigns.
* Ensure consistent employer messaging across all hiring platforms.
* Continuously improve candidate communication throughout the hiring journey.

**Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track recruitment KPIs including:

o Time\-to\-Hire

o Quality\-of\-Hire

o Candidate Conversion Rate

o Offer Acceptance Rate

o Source Effectiveness

o Candidate Experience

* Build dashboards and reports to identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Use recruitment data to drive hiring decisions and optimize performance.

**Required Qualifications**

Must Have

* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources.
* Experience hiring across technical, business, and operational roles.
* Strong understanding of structured interviewing and competency\-based hiring.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
* Strong prompt writing and AI workflow design skills.
* Experience improving recruitment processes through technology or automation.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Success in This Role**

**Within your first 90 days, you will be expected to:**

* Build AI\-powered recruitment workflows that significantly reduce manual administrative work.
* Improve hiring speed without compromising candidate quality.
* Establish structured interview and evaluation frameworks across departments.
* Build scalable talent pipelines for key business functions.
* Deliver a professional, consistent, and engaging candidate experience.
* Continuously optimize recruitment processes using AI and automation.

**Who You Are**

* You approach hiring as both a people function and an operational system.
* You believe excellent recruitment combines sound human judgment with intelligent technology.
* You naturally look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve decision\-making through data, and create scalable hiring processes.
* You are comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and continuously refining how recruitment is executed.
* Above all, you understand that great hiring is not measured by the number of interviews conducted, but by consistently bringing exceptional people into the organization through efficient, repeatable systems.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Fully remote work environment.
* Five\-day work week.
* Opportunity to build and lead an AI\-first recruitment function from the ground up.
* Work with a team that embraces innovation, automation, and continuous learning.

Pay: Up to ₹46,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Experience:

* building AI hiring workflows or recruitment automations.: 2 years (Required)
* n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.: 2 years (Required)

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana  

Company: Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About Us**
------------


Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable Healthcare Management partner. With several years of experience, we have perfected our end\-to\-end services in medical billing, A.R. management, and other essential healthcare operations.


We provide services to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US\-based Healthcare Company. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous growth drives our success. As we expand, we are seeking enthusiastic and responsible freshers to join our team as Process Associates.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Process Associate (Fresher) will support employee attendance tracking, workplace monitoring, and operational documentation. This is an entry\-level role suitable for candidates who are willing to learn, follow company policies, and work closely with HR, IT, and Security teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Attendance Monitoring**

* Assist in tracking daily employee attendance.
* Support verification of punctuality, absences, and late arrivals.
* Help generate daily, weekly, and monthly attendance reports.
* Share reports with HR and management teams.

### **CCTV \& Surveillance Support**

* Assist in monitoring CCTV systems to ensure workplace safety.
* Report suspicious activities or issues to the concerned team.
* Maintain basic logs of surveillance recordings.

### **Login/Logout Monitoring**

* Support tracking of employee login and logout times.
* Maintain shift\-wise working hour records.
* Identify basic discrepancies and report them to HR.

### **Alarm \& Access Control Support**

* Assist in maintaining alarm system codes and access permissions.
* Update access lists under supervision.
* Follow security procedures as per company policy.

### **Operational Support**

* Assist HR and Operations teams with attendance\-related tasks.
* Maintain records related to attendance and employee logs.
* Support onboarding activities such as system access setup.
* Assist during audits when required.

### **Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain organized records of attendance and login/logout data.
* Prepare reports under supervision.
* Provide required documents during internal reviews.

### **Support \& Coordination**

* Coordinate with HR, IT, and Security teams as needed.
* Provide support to employees regarding attendance queries.
* Follow instructions from supervisors and management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Mandatory)
* Freshers are welcome to apply
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, MS Word)
* Good communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Willingness to learn and work in night shifts

* Competitive salary (including EPF and ESIC)
* Health insurance
* Four\-day work week (Monday – Thursday)
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development
* Food and cab\-drop facilities available
* Night Shift: 4:45 PM to 3:45 AM

Please submit your resume detailing your academic background and interest in this role.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.


We boldly go.

**Where is the work:**


Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.  

At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.

 **What’s in it for you:**


Trane is excited to announce an incredible opportunity for a talented professional to join our team as a **Senior HR Generalist** for our Engineering \& Technology Centers in India (India ETCs). In this pivotal role, you will play the role of functional specialist providing support to the HR business partners and leaders. As a **Senior HR Generalist**, you will collaborate closely with the HRBPs, talent acquisition team, HR solutions team, T\&OC team and total rewards team to meet your deliverables.

 **Thrive at work and at home:**

* Inclusive Wellbeing Program, with resources to support your and your family’s physical, social, emotional, and financial well\-being.
* Comprehensive learning and development solutions, designed to support our people in connecting and growing, including Higher education/Certification reimbursement.
* Sense of belonging \& community through our Employee Resource Groups that foster our culture of inclusion.
* Volunteerism: 8 hours of paid time off per calendar year to volunteer with non\-profit charitable organizations.
* The Trane Technologies Helping Hands Fund to support employees facing financial challenges due to unforeseen personal hardship.

 **Where is the work:**  

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule (4 or more days onsite per week) based out of Bangalore.

 **What will you do:**

*The Senior HR Generalist is a newly created, future\-focused role within the India ETCs HR team. This role will serve as the analytics, AI, and operational backbone of the India ETCs HR team.*

 **People Analytics \& Data\-Driven HR**

* Build and maintain India HR dashboards and people analytics reports — tracking key metrics across talent, engagement, retention, and capability
* Translate HR data into actionable insights for HRBPs and business leaders — moving from activity metrics to business impact metrics
* Develop predictive analytics models — attrition risk, capability gap analysis, workforce planning
* Support the India HR Director in building a data\-driven HR reporting framework aligned to business outcomes

 **AI for HR**

* Lead the AI pilot initiative for India HR — identify use cases, evaluate tools, and drive adoption across the HR team within the framework, guidelines defined by the IT team.
* Explore and implement AI\-powered tools for talent acquisition support, learning personalization, and HR operations
* Build AI literacy within the India HR team — training, enablement, and ongoing support
* Stay current on AI and HR technology trends — bring relevant innovations to the India HR function

 **HR Operations \& Standard Work**

* Absorb and manage operational HRBP work from the ETC HR team thereby enabling HRBPs
* Maintain and improve HR standard work processes — LEAN mindset, continuous improvement
* Manage HR operational processes including data management, reporting cycles, and compliance tracking

title: HR Executive
description:
**Job Title: HR Executive**  

**Location: Amli Factory Silvassa**  

  

**ABOUT UNILEVER**  

With 3\.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.  

  

**FUNCTION INTRODUCTION**  

Human resource is a strategic function that facilitates effective people management practices. It helps organizations optimize their human capital to achieve their goals and objectives.  

  

**JOB PURPOSE:**  

Co\-create inclusive performance culture and partner business at sourcing units by implementing the right Unit HR Strategy in line with the company's larger HR, ER and SC strategies, owning capability interventions to support business transformation, while maintaining cordial IR in the ecosystem ensuring business continuity.  

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

**A. Business Partnering:**  

a) Assisting in executing the HR Strategy for the Unit.  

b) Guard and ensure the application of all Unilever Policies and governance requirements at Supply Units.  

  

**B. Manpower Planning and Recruitment:**  

a) Ensuring Manpower Availability of 100% Permanent and Contract Labour.  

b) Discipline Management: Tracking and Controlling Unauthorized Absenteeism.  

c) Assist the UHRM in designing key support systems – succession plans, mentoring schemes, coaching framework, induction programs etc.  

d) Identify sources of recruitment and maintain data bank of job aspirants.  

e) Facilitate recruitment, induction, and deployment of temporary workmen.  

f) Performance monitoring of new recruits to assess the effectiveness of the recruitment process.  

g) Organize induction training for new recruits including classroom, practical and on\-the\-job training.  

h) Co\-ordinate for appraisal reports of trainees, probationers and confirmed employees.  

  

**C. Cultural development and change and communication at unit:**  

a) Assist in Action planning and Driving major transformation initiatives like World Class Manufacturing, Future of Work etc.  

b) Drive Culture of Inclusion and improve representation on shopfloor w.r.t PwDs, Women and LGBTQ\+.  

c) Execute initiatives and projects aiming for site integration and collaborative work along the extended supply chain.  

d) Facilitate robust communication support, communication forums, team briefings, newsletters, etc.  

e) Establish connectivity with all levels of employees and get first\-hand information about Unit culture and develop change initiatives to set in the right culture.  

  

**D. Learning management at unit:**  

a) Facilitate Skill Mix Transformation at site through FoW Upskilling \& Reskilling Agenda as per Factory Master Plan (factory needs)  

b) Develop and Execute Annual Training Calendar and specify the learning objectives in line with business requirements.  

c) Facilitate preparation of Job rotation plans for on\-the\-job learning.  

d) Maintain data on learning activities. Maintain learning facilities and resources (eg technical training centre, learning centre).  

e) Coordinate with external/internal facilitators and institutions (ITI, CBWE, NGOs, etc.) Sensitivity: Public  

f) Operate the evaluation system and provide feedback. Analyse evaluation and plan for improvements.  

g) Retention of key talent through capability building and defining career progression.  

  

**E. Performance improvement and management at Unit**  

a) Monitor PDP system for the executives and workers. Ensure compliance to quality requirements, processes, and timings.  

b) Facilitate Performance reviews for blue collar population.  

c) Manage Employee Exits and Performance Counselling.  

  

**F. Managing Employee Relations \& Public Relations**  

a) Maintain Harmonious, productive, and progressive employee relations while effectively managing Union expectations.  

b) Collective bargaining and wage negotiations – Execute Negotiation strategy under the guidance of the team.  

c) Maintain cordial relations with all workmen by regular formal and informal interaction with workmen / workmen groups and opinion leaders on the shop floor.  

d) Play vital role in all conflict resolution pertaining to workmen.  

e) Establish and manage relationships with external Government and Political bodies.  

  

**G. CSR projects:**  

a) Ensure execution of ‘Prabhat’ – Our program to develop sustainable ecosystems and communities at Site Level.  

  

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**  

  

**EXPERIENCES AND QUALIFICATIONS –**  

* Essential Experience \- 2 to 6 Years of experience Educational Qualification
* Post Graduate Diploma or equivalent in Personnel Management/ Human Resource Management.

  

**KEY SKILLS REQUIRED** Union Management, Knowledge on statutory compliances, Stakeholder Management  

  

**Our commitment to Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion**  

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

title: Benefits Operations Analyst, 401k
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

The 401(k) team is within Benefits, one of Rippling's largest and most important product categories. As a 401(k) team member, you’ll ensure the seamless integration of clients’ payroll data with 401(k) recordkeepers, enabling automated management of their underlying employees' retirement benefits—avoiding our clients' hours of manual work. You’ll join at a highly exciting time as we scale our platform to allow hundreds of customers to integrate their payroll with 100\+ 401(k) vendors.

  

Rippling is looking for an Operations Specialist to help the project manage new 401(k) integration setups, resolve process and system challenges as they arise, and help root cause issues and contribute to fixes. This role will require significant engagement across customers, vendors, and several internal departments, and will have a major impact on the success of Rippling's 401(k) platform.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Drive 401(k) integration processes forward, maintaining momentum to stay on track and ensuring customer satisfaction and engagement throughout
* Communicate extensively with customers and vendors throughout the 401(k) integration process (typically 6\-10 weeks), providing step\-by\-step guidance
* Manage complex escalations and issues
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Account Management, and other internal stakeholders to root cause issues, come up with process/automation solutions, and help implement fixes to improve the customer onboarding process
* Develop documentation for new procedures and outline standard operating protocols

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2\-3 years of experience in a customer\-facing operational role, such as implementation, support, account management, or operations
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Excellent project management and organizational skills: ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, with varying deadlines and stakeholders, without any oversight
* A strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy: Ability to spot discrepancies that might go unnoticed by others
* A passion for processes, consistently seeking opportunities to address inefficiencies
* Experience with US payroll or 401(k) plans is a plus but not required

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: HR Partner, IND Corp HRP Team
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 3\+ years of human resource business partner or blend of operations and HR experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
* Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with fast\-moving, high\-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
* Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines
* Experience with learning assessments/analytics and the ability to influence others through data\-driven recommendations
* Experience mentoring, coaching, and influencing colleagues, collaborators, and stakeholders


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.  Employee onboarding, documentation, induction, and exit formalities.
   

  

 Performance management and employee engagement initiatives.

 HR policy implementation and compliance.

 Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
   

  

 Coordinate cross\-functional teams and improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 Drive accountability and process adherence.
